node.name: [Abandoned Road]
node.description: Clumps of grass and flowers dot the surface of an old gravel road. The prairie grasses on either side are slowly creeping in, and in a few years will have obscured the road completely. Every now and again, the wind carries the muted city noises from Shard, but otherwise all that can be heard is an almost silent rush of the wind through the grass.

node.name: [Abandoned Road]
node.description: Several long-abandoned crates sit on the side of the road. Some have cracked open, spilling their contents -- rusted unmarked tins, long-decayed pelts, sacks of putrid half-sprouted grains and seeds. The wind must have picked up some of the grains before they sprouted because a wide band of wheat, barley and oats grows in a widening arc from the crates.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Dwindling Way]
node.description: The road slopes downward towards the south into a small valley that stands before the mountains and the precarious Obsidian Pass, while to the north it leans into the forest slightly, winding around it like a coiled serpent.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Dwindling Way]
node.description: A wild rose bush twines around an old wooden fence, its thorns and blossoms radiant with savage beauty. Its fierceness is complemented by the pale lavender crocuses peeking softly from beneath their bed in the earth.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Dwindling Way]
node.description: Dust of the road gingerly settles, haggard brush beside the way loose in the dehydrated earth. Rocks and twisted branches skuttle about, the wind raking brakish claws of air over the dried dirt, eroding it away.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Winding Path]
node.description: A large willow tree solemnly bows its stately head over the road. A clearing beneath provides a quaint spot for a picnic, or respite from the day's long travels. Daisies and clementine open their sweet faces to the skies.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Winding Path]
node.description: Trees stand, sickly figures thrown against the spartan sky above. Their gnarled and twisting limbs seem to contort as if out of pain, their bodies those of hunchbacks mournfully bent over the roadside.

node.name: [Alongside the Forest, Winding Path]
node.description: The curves and dips in the road make for somewhat difficult travel, rocks and branches reaching out to deter the way. Most travelers seem to have cleared a passage through the debris.

node.name: [Alongside the Woods, Break in the Forest]
node.description: A ring of mushrooms solemnly crests a small opening in the forest. Small motes of light drift aimlessly around, settling on the moist grass below.

node.name: [Alongside the Woods, Winding Path]
node.description: A broken picket fence stands forlornly before the ruins of a small hut. Perhaps once the home of a forester or hermit, the place now stands in shambles, its memories sealed by time's unrelenting hand.

node.name: [Alongside the Woods, Winding Path]
node.description: Further south, twisted trees line the way. Their arching branches form a lifeless arbor overhead. A fallen log, rotting inside and out, rests to one side. The small flowers and grass nearby are in the process of consuming its crumbling body.

node.name: [Asemath Academy, Entrance]
node.description: The magnificent and renowned grey granite edifice of the Asemath Academy stands here before you. Solid and impressive, the buildings surround a wooded courtyard. Though severe in decor, there is no denying the high Elvish heritage in the design and execution of this learned establishment. Famed far and wide for its scholarship and teaching, many come here but few are allowed to enroll in its varied courses.

node.name: [Asemath Academy, Porte-cochere]
node.description: A flagstone pavement and a covered porte-cochere lead into the grounds of the Academy. West of you the campus opens out into a series of lovely wooded gardens with the buildings arranged in a quadrangle all around it. Students and professors stroll about, engaged in deep discussions or forming small study groups under the trees. To either side of the entrance are the administration offices and the admissions center.

node.name: [Barana's Shipyard, Receiving Yard]
node.description: The receiving yard of Barana's Shipyard and Boat Repair is a cluttered and hectic place. Huge piles of lumber wait to be formed into the ships this yard is known for. They vie for space with barrels of tar and kegs of nails. Piled neatly by the main office, a stack of ruler-straight ash poles, each the thickness of a stout Dwarf, await conversion into the proud masts of some ocean-going lady.

node.name: [Bards' Guild, Commons]
node.description: Always a flurry of activity, the guild commons is a place where bards young and old meet to trade tips, tales, and motifs. Thick, ruby-colored carpeting lines the floor while gold-laced red velvet curtains decorate the walls. Padded benches surround the area, a few already in use by travelling musicians resting their tired legs.

node.name: [Berolt's Dry Goods, Showroom]
node.description: Rough walls and floors covered with a gritty layer of dirt attest to the constant traffic in what must be one of the more popular establishments in town. Shelves and counters crowd together, displaying all manner of equipment for a rugged lifestyle in an orderly, if dustridden manner. Berolt, the proprietor, keeps a close eye on business, but still manages a quick, hearty laugh at a rather bawdy joke from a coarse-looking character who is obviously a regular visitor here.

node.name: [Beside the Jademist River, The Road to Shard]
node.description: The road moves slightly away from the river. To the south, expansive fields of golden wheat spread out as far as the eye can see, gilding the path to the crystal city beyond.

node.name: [Beside the Jademist River, The Road to Shard]
node.description: A slender sword of gleaming silver heralds the presence of Shard on the distant southern horizon where the city shimmers in the sun. The blackness of the forest to the north is easily forgotten, even in the distant presence of such splendor. The Jademist River vanishes on its way southeast, disappearing into fields of golden wheat.

node.name: [Beside the Jademist River, The Road to Shard]
node.description: The churning rapids of the Jademist River slow as they skirt the road, their fine mist settling over the ground and curling about you in lazy circles. The jagged mountains break out of the canopy of dense forest, their snowy white peaks distant and austere.

node.name: [Beside the Jademist River, The Road to Shard]
node.description: The rapids of the Jademist rush by, hurrying southeastward. Small flowers dare to bloom near the water's edge, petals bearing foamy droplets that have strayed from their path. The road dances dangerously close to the angry river, playing touch-and-go with the high bank as it winds south and north.

node.name: [Beside the Jademist River, The Road to Shard]
node.description: The river is at its widest and most furious here. Like an angered lioness, it rages southward as if caught in a frenzy. Rapids rush by, water breaking against rocks and stony banks. The gentle fog that hazes over the moving surface partially hides the danger of being swept away in the violent currents.

node.name: [Chasm, Vertical Pothole]
node.description: Vegetation creeps in and out of the face of the rock. One possible avenue for further exploration appears to be a narrow ledge, barely wide enough to place the toe of a boot-clad foot, that leads straight up the side of the deep chasm.

node.name: [Chasm, Vertical Pothole]
node.description: The steep climb shows no signs of leveling out nor of providing any further assistance to a weary mountaineer. Writhing gently inside a craggy niche, a large black snake attempts to wriggle out of a withered skin, its cloud-covered eyes both piercing and merciless.

node.name: [Chasm, Vertical Pothole]
node.description: A stand of tall trees comes into view overhead, further dimming the light and making it increasingly difficult to find a foothold up through the pothole. Caution is absolutely necessary to prevent a case of vertigo from settling in and overwhelming the senses.

node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite stand and an oaken table sit on the granite floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A deobar rack hangs on the lunat walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room.

A granite stand and an oaken table sit on the granite floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A deobar rack hangs on the lunat walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room.

A granite table and an oaken table sit on the granite floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A granite rack hangs on the oaken walls. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a strong sit odor wafts about.

An oaken table and a glass table sit on the oaken floor, with a black oak trunk and a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A glass rack hangs on the silk-covered walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor.

node.name: [Couri's Curious Curios, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass table and an oaken table sit on the oaken floor, with a glass trunk and a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A glass rack hangs on the silk-covered walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: The road hugs the river, culminating in a bridge that once spanned the flow, leading to the mouth of the valley. Scorched, scarred earthworks are all that now remain of a long abandoned fortification. The great rents in the defenses must have been torn by a devastating force, exposing a massive shard of black rock resting at its heart.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: From this small rise, the surrounding terrain is clearly visible. The river lies to the northwest, while to the northeast a massive rockslide crests across the road as it snakes its way around a buckle in the ravine wall. To the west, the route continues past a collection of pikes displaying sun-bleached skulls capped with Dwarven great helms.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: Burned stumps line a path littered with boulders, rocks and chunks of fused slag. The forest appears to shy away from shattered trees that add to the look of devastation. The road continues southwest while a jagged rockslide blocks the way east.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: The forest rises to the north of the roadway while the scarred wall of the ravine rises to the south. Some cataclysmic force fractured the cliff face above, causing a tumult of rock and debris to cascade across the road.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: An occasional twittering bird breaks the silence of the forest canopy that hangs over this stretch of road. Boughs of mikkhalbamar block most of the sky from view. The pathway widens to the southwest while a rain-washed gully blocks the way east.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: The forest crowds the road as the neglected path winds its way through a depression in the valley floor. Rainwater and mountain snowmelt have eroded a sharp gully that blocks the way westward. No movement comes from the surrounding trees despite an occasional breeze passing through the area.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: The overgrown roadway stretches to the southwest, while a section of crushed fence leads to a rocky shelf above. The sound of rushing water can be heard from the north where a huge, fallen tree has been toppled away from the road, creating a narrow void through the underbrush.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Corral]
node.description: The mountain's flank flattens, creating a broad ledge between the cliffs above and the forest below. A fence of stout mikkalbamar logs has been erected around the area to create an enclosure in which the Dragon Priests train their war mounts, but some great force has left the barricade in ruins here.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Corral]
node.description: The mountain's flank flattens, creating a broad ledge between the cliffs above and the forest below. A fence of stout mikkhalbamar logs has been erected around the area to create an enclosure in which the Dragon Priests train their war mounts. Through a massive, open gate to the southeast, the road continues toward the mountain itself.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Roadway]
node.description: As the open roadway clings to the massive flank of the mountain, the forest seems to glower angrily, its branches clawing for complete dominion of the valley. Only the crushing passage of enormous beasts has kept the mikkhalbamar at bay. A tangled deadfall stretches deep into the trees while a massive crag to the south opens into a narrow canyon walled by sheer cliffs.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Granite Canyon]
node.description: Over fifty paces in height, the granite walls of this canyon lean toward each other, allowing little light to reach the floor. The near-vertical cliffs and fallen boulders alike have been worn smooth by the action of water, but the accumulation of silt and animal remains indicates that its source has long since been diverted. The skeleton of a massive korograth rises to one side of the path.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Granite Canyon]
node.description: The sheer walls of the defile tower overhead, crowding ever closer together. Only a thin ribbon of sky remains visible through the incomplete arch above. Occasional, rumbling thumps echo from the east and west, causing gravel to cascade to the canyon floor. Strangely, the pathway is clear of fallen rock.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Korograth Lair]
node.description: The walls of the chasm gradually bow toward each other until they finally embrace, forming a protective arch over the terminus of the canyon. The floor of the enclosure has been quarried to create a ring of colossal depressions where shattered, young mikkhalbamar trunks and rounded stones have been laid as bedding material. Nestled between these korograth roosts, a tunnel mouth leads into the rock face.

node.name: [Cragstone Vale, Tunnel]
node.description: Rising steeply from a rough-hewn opening, the passage is large enough for several mounted S'Kra Mur to ride abreast. Gouges of chisels and other marks of excavation abound, but the natural crack splitting the tunnel's ceiling indicates that this was once little more than a natural fissure in the flank of the mountain. The flickering glow of countless torches, affixed to the walls with thick metal brackets, bathe the passage in a pale yellow light.

node.name: [Crossing, East Gate Battlements]
node.description: From this height, the ruins of Ulf'Hara Keep are visible in the far distance, and southward flows the churning Segoltha River. Two of the wall's embrasures contain signal pots, an archaic backup should gwethdesuan or thoughtcast fail. The cobbled walkway here is directly atop Crossing's eastern gate, overlooking the road into town.

node.name: [Crystal Forest, Frozen Glade]
node.description: The lush greenery of lower thickets abruptly gives way to a pale petrified wood as the path winds along the mountain. Snow hangs over the trees throughout the year at this altitude, glistening in the daylight. Sounds of running water can be heard from a stream at the opposite end of the glade, pouring down from further up the mountain.

node.name: [Crystal Forest, Frozen Glade]
node.description: Mottled leaves crunch underfoot, not because they are dry and dead, but rather as a result of the intense accumulation of icy condensation. Rivulets of melting snow burrow through the underbrush to compound the damp, slippery surface. Shielded by thick pines, the homes stretch further into the forest.

node.name: [Crystal Forest, Frozen Glade]
node.description: Heavy snow weighs down the pine boughs along the borders of the meadow, and dull plops from fallen clumps disrupt the night atmosphere. Nocturnal birds flit through the trees, ignoring the chilly winds to seek comfort and companionship among the branches. Trunks as thick as boulders promise an imposing defense for their loyal inhabitants.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Lobby]
node.description: The ceiling here is raised three stories high with a bronzed statue of an Elothean female in the center of the room. As they move across the rust-colored tiles, the visitors' footfalls and voices echo sharply off the elaborate cornices. A listings board on the far wall has an ornate gilded frame.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Rotunda]
node.description: This imposing circular room is the hub of the Crystal Plaza. Arches in all directions stand between fluted pilasters on curved sandstone walls. A sculpted relief of the province of Ilithi spans the dome of brass. The golden marble floor gleams and is free of any furniture or carpet to distract from the room's beauty.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, The Sea]
node.description: A mural spans the room on all four walls. Starting from the northern vantage point, a bustling seaport on a bright sunny day leads to a starlit night and a solitary frigate with billowing white sails. Turning from east to south, a stylized cloud angrily blows, causing swells and massive waves curling around a clipper ship. On the western wall, a tropical beach, resplendent with palms and bright pink crabs, is deserted but for a single slanted piece of mast stuck in the sand with a tattered black flag.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Food Court]
node.description: Three low walls around each table and chairs provide the semblance of privacy. Shoppers and tradesmen carry on conversations and business deals while partaking of the food and drink set out on the carts along the wall. A solemn Elothean man keeps a careful eye on the staff that moves quietly around the room, preventing any from sneaking into the nearby shops.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Storage]
node.description: Though piled high from floor to ceiling against each wall, boxes are stored in a neat fashion. Large stenciled numbers and letters on each give a sense of organization even if the meaning of each is not evident. A push cart with chains sits waiting in the middle of the room, probably used in the transfer of the stored wares.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Luminous Room]
node.description: Exquisite crystal glasses and bowls are showcased in niches along both long walls of the room. A central chandelier provides light that reflects off the glistening decorations. Shoppers travel leisurely in and out of the entrances to the privately-owned shops.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Oak Room]
node.description: Potted palms and ferns in terracotta urns have been arranged in circle around a towering oak that rises through the ceiling in the center of the room. Curved marble benches ring the flora, providing a place for harried husbands or tired shoppers to rest. The seating also secures a vantage point for watching who is going in and out of the entries to the various shops.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Prism Room]
node.description: Crystals of varied shapes and sizes hang from the ceiling on silver wires cut to different lengths. A light draft from channels cut at the top of the walls makes the prisms slowly twist and turn to spray the walls with color. Runners branching off a center aisle lead to the entrances of each shop.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Play Yard]
node.description: Brightly painted plaster mushrooms and toadstools provide wide stepping stones around the room. Straw piled high around the odd playthings creates a safe place to fall if any adventurous child loses his or her step. Small animals and fanciful fae are the perfect handholds for vaulting onto the fungi. A path of pink and blue bricks meanders through, with smaller routes leading to the entrances of the shops.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Stormshine Room]
node.description: A tile mosaic spans the curved walls and shifts from ominously dark grey storm clouds to billowing white clouds in a brilliant blue sky. Overhead, a lantern shielded by cloudy crystal on one side and clear amber on the other complements the aesthetic as it casts dimmed light to the stormy side of the room and sunny yellow light to the other. A single long bench curves around some protective railing that overlooks the rotunda below.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Observatory Room]
node.description: A false ceiling patterned to resemble a starry night sky hangs overhead. Through impressive engineering, large crystalline orbs, each colored to simulate one of Elanthia's moons, move across the sky as their real counterparts would and provide tinted illumination for patrons to navigate by. The varied aromas of the foods being prepared and served in the food court below suffuse the air. Tall windows between the shopfronts grant a modest view of the true sky outside.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, River Room]
node.description: Water falls thunderously from a spout in one wall near the ceiling, creating a small waterfall that still manages to cast misty spray around the pool in the floor. A river speeds out from the pool and winds its way around the shop entrances, and small bridges cross it at key points to provide access. While visually novel in its design, the crashing and rushing water creates enough noise that visitors frequently yell at their companions just to be heard.

node.name: [Crystal Plaza, Treehouse Room]
node.description: The canopy of the giant oak below explodes out from the floor here. The overall design strongly resembles a treehouse with rope bridge-like pathways snaking through and around the branches. Beyond the roped-off areas, varieties of ivy and colorfully flowering vines creep along the ground and over the shop entrances. The air is filled with strong floral scents atop earthy undertones.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: A bitter chill lingers in the air and sends shivers to creep along your spine. Dense clusters of mountain ash trees, heavily laden with icicles, line the rocky trail and bow reverently towards the earth.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Rows of spruce and fir trees rise neatly towards a pinnacle far ahead over the horizon. Silence looms, marred only by the occasional skitter of some small creature foraging for the rare morsel of food beneath the ice and snow.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Tiny pebbles crunch noisily underfoot as parcels of snow turn to patches of withered, brown grass. Occasionally, your footsteps splash into a puddle of icy water, interrupting the solitude.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: The soft chitter of a frisky squirrel quickly flitting from tree to tree overhead captures your attention. Deep green ground ivy clusters in neat patches across the rocky path, grasping relentlessly for any feasible handhold on the earth.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: A persistent tap-tap-tap and then another, deeper tap-tap-tap throbs at the temple as some unseen woodpecker overhead forages for insects deep in the bark of a rowan tree. Fescue grasses grow tall around the base of each tree, vying for any available moisture.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Silverwood trees line the hard-packed rocky path, casting long pockets of shadow across the brush. Red and black berries, in various stages of ripeness, dangle invitingly across the trail from the myriad of chokecherry bushes stealthily hidden in the brown grass.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Tamarisk bushes display their feathery tendrils, nearly as delicate as the web of a spider. Each footfall creates a rather hollow sound upon the nearly dry earth. Stretched full-length across the trail lies a decaying old log.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Willowy branches reach out from the low bushes lining both sides of the trail. Slender fingers laced with thorns await any opportunity to snag an errant coat sleeve or a patch of bare flesh, claiming it for their own.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Utter stillness and the grandiose play of nature settles across the landscape. Wildflowers form an elegant multicolored drapery across the towering bluff and lend a sweet aroma to the cool mountain air.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Deep shadows begin to fall long across the hillside as the foliage grows denser. Birds chitter softly back and forth to each other from the safety of the trees, as if signaling a quiet warning to all who traverse the woodlands.

node.name: [Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]
node.description: Nature, with all its mysterious forces, works undisturbed in this remote wilderness. The soft gurgle of nearby waters becomes welcome music to the ears, though the stand of towering silverwood and spruce trees on the horizon does not offer up the same invitation.

node.name: [Deame's Dreams And Follies, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass shelf and a glass rack hang on the silk-covered walls, with a glass vanity along the edges of the room. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor. A glass cart sits alone on the granite floor. A strong sits odor wafts about, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Deame's Dreams And Follies, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass shelf and a glass rack hang on the silk-covered walls, with a glass vanity along the edges of the room. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor. A glass cart sits alone on the granite floor. A strong sits odor wafts about, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Deobar Bower Gate, Esouvar Deriel]
node.description: A tall gate rises over a well-kept road. Ironwood trees gather in patches around the steep city walls, their dark forms casting shadows over the thin brush. The slender bows and branches that make the thick panels of the gateway into Leth curve and twist, their still-tender bark formed into a living arch by a lifesculptor's hand.

node.name: [Diamonds, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bulky stone sales counter with a gilded crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ornate smokewood chest sits on the white-veined pink marble floor, with a large teak armoire and a heavy ironwood packing crate placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Some polished scrimshaw shelves hangs on the white-veined pink marble walls, with a tower of cracked clay bricks along the edges of the room. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [Diamonds, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bulky stone sales counter with a gilded crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ornate smokewood chest sits on the white-veined pink marble floor, with a large teak armoire and a heavy ironwood packing crate placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [Drackyn's Distinguished Doodads, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and a granite worktable sit on the steel-lined floor, with a steel case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. An ironwood rack hangs on the granite walls, with an oak armoir along the edges of the room. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Drackyn's Distinguished Doodads, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite worktable and an oaken table sit on the steel-lined floor, with a steel case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. An ironwood rack hangs on the granite walls, with an oak armoir along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, Edge of the Wood]
node.description: Very little sunlight streaks through the dense canopy of brush to the north. Even here, where the forest thins, the lingering darkness of the trees seems to settle like an ill wind brushing over a grave.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, A Dark Path]
node.description: To the south and the east, the glistening movement of water glimmers brightly through the scale-like leaves of the dense growth surrounding the road, the distant sound of rushing water confirming the presence of a river nearby. The forest stands tall and stark, a wall of impermeable vegetation save where the road has carved its way through.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, A Dark Path]
node.description: The forest begins to lose some of its denseness as it thins to the south. The canopy above is interspersed with shafts of light, the trees allowing light to fall through to dapple the path below them.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, A Dark Path]
node.description: Rocks and stones lie scattered along the path, the road crumbling as roots and vines grow into it. This is a place not often walked by travelers. The denseness of nature, as if this was her very heart, is quite apparent. To the east, a faint break in the walls of green shows an otherwise unnoticeable branch in the path.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, A Dark Path]
node.description: The dark twisting forms of eerie trees curl and twine towards the sky. Gnarled branches bearing dense leaves with sharp edges glisten with a keen edge.

node.name: [Dragon's Breath Forest, A Dark Path]
node.description: Trees close in around you, dark shadows like angry ghosts looming sullenly in unidentifiable shapes. A flash of movement, a rustle in the leaves, and it is easy to understand why so many swear that this forest possesses a preternatural sentience. Leaves, sharp like keen, straight blades, extend from the dense underbrush to languidly stab at the air.

node.name: [Dragon's Cache, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass stand and a glass table sit on the granite floor, with a glass case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A granite endtable and a granite bar line the oak walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and a strong sit odor wafts about.

node.name: [Dragon's Cache, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass stand and a glass table sit on the granite floor, with a glass case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A granite endtable and a granite bar line the oak walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and a strong sit odor wafts about.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Twisting Trail]
node.description: A narrow route makes its way up a sharp slope through the forest, daylight managing to escape through the trees at broken intervals. Flat areas scattered along the path offer a brief respite from the climb, from which patches of Wyvern Road can be glimpsed below.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Mountain Foothills]
node.description: The trail becomes spotty as it meanders its way along the rock strewn canyon beside a wide riverbed containing a tiny trickle of water. Sage and juniper cover backsides of steep tan sandstone hogback ridges that angle downward toward Shard. Underbrush rustles as tiny brown sparrows, blue-bellied lizards, and russet squirrels forage for food.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Mountain Foothills]
node.description: Winding its way around one of the steep ridges, the rutted path travels between hills. Small dirty gray white patches fill the chill shadows cast by an abundance of thick brush and large stately oaks. High overhead a kestrel floats, hovering on updrafts as it circles for game.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Mountain Foothills]
node.description: The foothills quickly bow in submission to the majesty of the Spine of the World Dragon Mountains. Icespear Peak dominates the view as it thrusts impressively skyward vanishing into fleecy clouds that wreath the summit in mystery. The white robed mountains seem to extend into infinity to both the east and west, and offer little in the way of passage.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Canyon Trail]
node.description: Following the narrow gorge, the path becomes arduous as it climbs over rock falls and between tangles of river debris. High upon the canyon rim, abundant pine, fir, and spruce flourish but grow more sparse as they descend upon the canyon walls until only the occasional doughty bush or tenacious pine cling precariously to the mountainside.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, River Camp]
node.description: The canyon widens, its slope less severe, as the trail climbs steeply into the mountains. Icy clear water trickles though a small channel in the boulder strewn stream bed. A small circle of charcoal blackened stones grace a small flat sandbar that is nestled like a comb between the braids of the twining riverbed.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Mountain Shadow]
node.description: Temperature drops dramatically as the canyon weaves westerly into the shadow of the World Dragon's Spine. Abruptly, the scenery is transformed into a wonderland of ice that glitters and shimmers in the canyon as the trickling stream finds its source at the melting edge of a wide and frozen river. Icicle lances drape from seeps on the ice shattered canyon walls.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Astrar's Sorrow]
node.description: The canyon terminates in frosty splendor, though the trail continues on, steeply switch-backing its way up the slick mountainside beside a stunning waterfall. Hanging from a valley far above, Astrar's Sorrow descends as a glittering cascade of frozen water forming a pleated veil of icy tears that fall perpetually without movement to the solid river of ice below.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, Behind the Waterfall]
node.description: Footing becomes quite treacherous here as each new step brings forth more uncertainty. Tiny rivulets of icy water trickle down from the waterfall and freeze, adding to the already slippery sheet of ice on the ground. The more adventurous traveler might either chance the dark woodlands ahead or ferret out some way to penetrate and attempt to swim the frozen river. The less daring of souls will quickly retreat from whence they came.

node.name: [Dragon's Spine, River Camp]
node.description: The canyon widens, its slope less severe, as the trail climbs steeply into the mountains. Icy clear water trickles though a small channel in the boulder strewn stream bed. A small circle of charcoal blackened stones grace a small flat sandbar that is nestled like a comb between the braids of the twining riverbed.

node.name: [Dream Vision, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood worktable and an oaken table sit on the bare floor. A strong sit odor wafts about, and small piles of garbage litter the floor. The oaken walls are unadorned. Grime has collected along the walls, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [Dream Vision, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood worktable and an oaken table sit on the bare floor. A strong sit odor wafts about, and small piles of garbage litter the floor. The oaken walls are unadorned. Grime has collected along the walls, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [Droughtman's Compound, The Maze]
node.description: The walls of the maze are constructed of smooth black marble with web-like veins of gold and silver that stand out boldly against the dark background. The floors are covered with iron grating allowing for more than adequate drainage of any fluids which might be spilled within the confines of the labyrinth. Several flickering torches are placed in gold trimmed sconces spaced evenly along the passage walls.

node.name: [Droughtman's Compound, The Maze]
node.description: The walls of the maze are constructed of smooth black marble with web-like veins of gold and silver that stand out boldly against the dark background. The floors are covered with iron grating allowing for more than adequate drainage of any fluids which might be spilled within the confines of the labyrinth. Several extinguished torches are placed in gold trimmed sconces spaced evenly along the passage walls.

node.name: [Droughtman's Maze, Contestant's Box]
node.description: This appears to be a preparation room for the maze contestants. Aside from the signage posted along its western wall, the room is completely bare and devoid of any furniture or decoration.

node.name: [Droughtman's Maze, Recovery Room]
node.description: The noise from the cheering spectators, although muffled, can still be heard echoing off the walls of this comfortably cooled room.

node.name: [Droughtman's Maze, Grand Hall]
node.description: Suspended between jewel-toned pennants overhead, ornate oil lanterns softly illuminate the grand entry hall of Droughtman's Maze. Eager contestants crowd the mahogany registration desk at the center of the chamber, while a gold-carpeted staircase dominates the northern wall, providing access to the observation deck.

node.name: [Dumana's Scrolls, Sales Floor]
node.description: A gold-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A steel rack hangs on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a steel cabinet along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Dumana's Scrolls, Sales Floor]
node.description: A gold-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A steel rack hangs on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a steel cabinet along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Dwarf Brothers Trading Emporium, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass stand and an ironwood table sit on the bare floor. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A lunat cabinet stands against the oaken walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and a strong sit odor wafts about.

node.name: [Dwarf Brothers Trading Emporium, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. node.name: [East Kermoria Trading Company, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the granite floor, with a granite trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A strong sits odor wafts about, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. An ironwood cabinet stands against the silk-covered walls. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room.

node.name: [East Trade Route, Journey's Rest]
node.description: For centuries, the Journey's Rest has been a stopping point for travelers arriving to and leaving from the fabled city of Shard. Marble benches provide a place to rest weary feet and chat with passing merchants or wanderers. To the east lies an expanse of farm fields stretching as far as the naked eye can see.

node.name: [Eastern Tier, Outside Gate]
node.description: The eastern gate of the Crossing stands before you, an incomplete, but serviceable stone structure. To the north are grey slate hills rising out of dense clumps of deobar trees and groves of tall almur poplars. The land to the east is flat, and dips and rises almost imperceptibly into the distance. A single, wide path winds through it, surrounded by ruins, debris and small huts.

node.name: [Edge of the Fields, Dusky Path]
node.description: An ocean of golden wheat stretches as far as the eye can see. Wooden yokes and leather harness rest over a weathered oak fence, shiny from use. Footprints left by meandering livestock are impressed into the soft, fallow earth below.

node.name: [Edge of the Fields, Dusky Path]
node.description: A dusky path leads south, deeper into the fields, and north towards the forest. The tip of Wyvern Mountain peeks over the abundant grains, as do the tall spires of Shard in the distance.

node.name: [Edge of the Wood, The Western Riverbank]
node.description: A small white bridge gracefully arches over the rushing water of the furious Jademist River. The soft pattering of the water's movements sings a cadence as alluring as any fae's melody. A curious pale green fog lurks around the stones near the edge of the riverbank, occluding the rapidly shifting surface.

node.name: [Edge of the Wood, Western Riverbank]
node.description: A great river courses strong and proud beside the road, a light mist softly rising from its surface. Rocks jutting from the banks try to catch the running water, daring to thwart its progress, yet it runs on steadily.

node.name: [Edge of the Wood, The Western Riverbank]
node.description: The western riverbank of the Jademist River flanks the road, both for the moment holding a mutual course through Ilithi. Further north lies the dense lushness of the Dragon's Breath Forest, while to the south, the road meanders toward the mystical Lake of Tears.

node.name: [Edge of the Wood, Cove by the River]
node.description: A small cove dips into the edge of the forest, the trees leaning back just enough to allow a shallow pool to collect beneath them, their bright green leaves skimming against the glass-like surface of the water.

node.name: [Endrus Forest, Crossroads]
node.description: A stand of lofty ironwood trees chokes the winding road which narrows to barely a wagon's width. Thick, bulbous roots snake over the earth, and gnarled branches twist overhead nearly blotting out the sky. Odd noises and beastly grunts drift from the malevolent shadows, lending truth to the bardic myths of a haunted forest along the trade route.

node.name: [Erzo's Illicit Imports, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood table sits on the bare floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. The shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor. An ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners, and small puddles of standing water litter the floor.

node.name: [Erzo's Illicit Imports, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. node.name: [Everything Ever, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. Some black oak shelves and a black oak rack hang on the oaken walls, with a black oak armoir and a black oak vanity along the edges of the room. A strong sits odor wafts about, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force. A black oak desk sits alone on the bare floor. Dust has collected in the corners, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Faery Fancies Boutique, Sales Floor]
node.description: A gold-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and a large square table crafted from rich red cherrywood sit on the soft purple-tiled floor, with a gold-veined black marble pedestal placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials and a massive iroko wardrobe with decorative ironwork line the burgundy-papered walls with fanciful scrollwork.

node.name: [Faldesu River, South Bank]
node.description: A high, rocky bank supports the remains of a large stone bridge which once spanned the river. From across the wide river the sounds of Riverhaven carry. Further to the east, the swift waters slow near the tall reeds of an encroaching marsh.

node.name: [Faldesu River]
node.description: The swift waters of the river swirl violently, causing an undertow which threatens to drag down unwary swimmers. To the south, the bank rises like a stony wave, an image belied by the deteriorating ruins of an old stone bridge.

node.name: [Faldesu River]
node.description: The swift waters of the river swirl violently, causing an undertow which threatens to drag down unwary swimmers. To the south, the remains of a crumbling bridge can easily be seen on the bank.

node.name: [Faldesu River]
node.description: An enormous slab of rock is upthrust in the river to the north, cutting the water like a knife. Downriver of the formation a low, forested island lies, a green tail to a stony comet.

node.name: [Faldesu River]
node.description: The rushing waters split around a huge boulder rising out of the river to the east. The rock formation is worn inward where the water has taken its toll, but higher up on the rock garlands of green vines adorn the crown.

node.name: [Faldesu River, North Bank]
node.description: The Riverhaven town wall stretches out into the waters a short distance upriver from a crumbling stone bridge. The sounds of pleading beggars and creaking merchant wagons grate against the peaceful sounds of the rolling river. Small fishing boats bob in the sheltered cove formed by the town wall, their weather-wary owners busy on the bank mending nets and patching sail.

node.name: [Family Kronar, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with an oak trunk and a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. The shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room. A glass rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a deobar cabinet along the edges of the room. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and a strong sits odor wafts about.

node.name: [Fang Cove, Fate's Fortune Lane]
node.description: A towering marble archway opens a gap in the wall to the north and separates the ongoing construction and somewhat more refined completed structures of Fate's Fortune Lane from the crude structures and makeshift walkway along the beach. The entrance to a squat, wide bungalow sits in opposition to the arch, and the sheltering cliffs of Fang's Peak rise up from behind it. To either side of the arch, cobblestones of different shapes and sizes have been laid out to form the wide Fate's Fortune Lane.

node.name: [Fang Cove, Walkway]
node.description: Sweet aromas drift from the two-story building that dominates the area near the cove's pier. A decorative pole holds a dragon-shaped lantern, its bright flame diligently flickering into the night. Groups of inhabitants gather around white wicker chairs and tables beneath the illumination to talk of the day's happenings in the small community while others go inside for more comfortable arrangements.

node.name: [Fang Cove, Walkway]
node.description: A spiked-iron fence lines the walkway, keeping stray beasts and children from tumbling down the rocky outcrop below. Someone has braided pink ribbon through a couple of the fence posts, leaving the ends to flutter in the breeze. The sea's ever-rolling waves break softly upon the nearby shore and keep at bay most of the yips and howls of the night's prowling creatures.

node.name: [Fang Cove, Walkway]

node.name: [Fang Cove, Walkway]
node.description: A simple wooden fence, crafted from the splintered remains of a ship's framework and barbed wire, lines the walkway to keep stray beasts and children from tumbling down the rocky outcrop below. A long strip of pale sandy beach can be seen beyond a gate to the east. A hearty dolphin vine weaves itself through the bars of the fence post, its fragrant blooms scenting the surrounding air.

node.name: [Fang Cove, Walkway]
node.description: A fairy wind-chime plays sweet tunes while passing travelers stroll by a tiny shop. Pale ribbons stream from above its doors. A wooden bench painted snow white sits beside the shop and opposite an iron-wrought gate that leads to the beach below.

node.name: [Fayrin's Rest, Telgi Mod'Sunhin]
node.description: Massive oaks extend a silver-grey canopy of leaves that fades quickly into inkblack darkness from here to the east, north and south. The air shimmers and whispers sibilantly of long growth and gradual decay. A few slender cedars and elm mark the beginning of a denser forest to the west, one marked by greater undergrowth and steeper rises.

node.name: [Fayrin's Rest, Telgi Mod'Sunhin]
node.description: The road winds with easy grace through a lightly wooded clearing. A large burrow of Halflings snuggles against a cedar to the north, fitted with a series of curtained windows and filtered vents. To the other side of the Telgi is an ancient oak, gnarled with age and disease.

node.name: [Fayrin's Rest, Anloraten Crossing]
node.description: It is not much of a meeting place for roads and their travelers: a broad lane wandering through an impressive forest, a dirt path created from disturbed underbrush. But such as it is, this crossing is a major traffic area for Fayrin's Rest. Several local residents sit on benches in front of small dwellings to watch the arrivals and departures, by turns amused, pleased, curious and disdainful of what they see.

node.name: [Fayrin's Rest, Telgi Mod'Sunhin]
node.description: A burrow and a few inconspicuous squat houses sit off both sides of the road, almost completely concealed by oaks and cedars, elms and waves of rolling brown earth. A few Halfling children watch you discreetly as they create and manage a town several feet long, comprised of small pebbles, twigs and a devoured turkey leg. One of the children winks so briefly that it might have been a joke shared among the light, the thin emerald shade and the two of you.

node.name: [Fayrin's Rest, Telgi Mod'Sunhin]
node.description: The forest is shady here, beneath towering oaks that spread their branches like gods chanting spells of creation. Small cylindrical houses of limed earth and wood cluster at ground level. People engaged in gardening and chatting with neighbors glance briefly your way and nod, before returning to their activities.

node.name: [First Bank of Ilithi, Coin Exchange]
node.description: The walls of this relatively small alcove rise up in a smooth, rounded arch of glossy white marble. A friendly-looking Elven man stands behind a desk with fifteen small drawers in it, taking coins and exchanging them for the local currency.

node.name: [First Bank of Ilithi, Teller's Windows]
node.description: Polished walnut windows and paneling separate the customers from the tellers and vault against the back of the wall. Several young and pretty Elothean men and women stand behind bars of an anlora-avtoma and steel alloy to process transactions. A gleaming brass sign is embedded into the west wall, stating the bank's policies.

node.name: [First Council Banking, Vestibule]
node.description: Adobe clings to the latticework of woven bamboo that forms the domed structure overhead. A set of shallow steps on one side of the room leads downward at an angle that makes it clear that the area at its other end is outside the walls of this abode. A hatch-covered ladder resides on the other side of the room and leads straight down.

node.name: [First Council Banking, Vault]
node.description: Little more than a deep hole, the below-ground sod structure is reinforced with vine-lashed lengths of weathered wood. Jar-covered shelves line every bit of space available while a lone set of steps provide the only entrance to and exit from the community's small bank -- a liberal description of the surroundings. No windows or tellers are present, only guards that stand with their backs to the wall on either side of the steps so they can keep an eye on everything that happens.

node.name: [First Provincial Bank, Lobby]
node.description: Marble tiled floors covered with heavy rugs and walls of polished jasper that gleam a cool blue mark this bank as solid and secure (and expensive). An official money-changing booth is to one side and a row of tellers windows faces you. Several guards, armed and armored, stand ready for trouble of any sort. Near the tellers stands a table of fine wood for those who need to do some writing.

node.name: [First Provincial Bank, Lobby]

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]
node.description: The well-worn path winds its way erratically between and around the few hardy bushes and shrubs that cling to the perpetually muddy riverbank. Sparse vegetation interspersed with forgotten whiskey bottles and broken fishing poles lines the edges of the beaten track between the river to the west and the trail running southeast to the trade route.

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]
node.description: The path continues along a slight slope as it winds its way beside the river. Large rocks and mossy boulders make the way a bit more treacherous, and the shadows cast by the large trees to the south cause the area to stay quite moist. The blaring of a ferry's horn can be heard occasionally, far in the distance.

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]
node.description: The tree-lined trail winds an erratic route along the riverbank, eternally muddy and smelling of fish. The bank drops off steeply into the river below, a deadly climb for anyone foolish enough to try.

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]
node.description: The vegetation grows thickly here, fertilized by the steady stream of birds and wildlife attracted to the nearby river. To the west, the riverbank subsides into a more gradual slope, easing entrance into the water for animals and fishermen alike. Here however, the man-made bank drops off treacherously, its slippery slope inviting the sounds of the river to permeate the area.

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, River Bank]
node.description: Muddy riverbank gives way to a grassy path, as a footpath slopes down to the shore. The call of shorebirds echoes through the area, mixed with the sounds of buzzing insects and scurrying rodents in the underbrush.

node.name: [Fisherman's Trail, Near the Wreck]
node.description: In the tiny cove, the bulk of a wrecked ship lies beached along the shore to the west. Lying on its side, it is an easy scramble up a pile of debris to the main deck. Near the shore, a small firepit, surrounded by stumps, is filled with half-burned wood and ashes. Snapped fishing lines and rusted hooks litter the ground, testifying to the normal usage of the cove.

node.name: [Foothills, Steep Path]
node.description: The mountains begin reclaiming road here, their rocky mouths and jagged teeth piercing the passage with fang and claw. Even the very sky seems to betray the land, for water and wind erode the dirt of the route away, leaving patches of bare rock facing the lone sky, naked to plain sight.

node.name: [Foothills, Artesian Well]
node.description: An old artesian well, still used by traveler and trader alike, stands alone in the dark shadow of the great mountains before it. Oblivious to the road, to the northern city of Leth, to the dark peaks in the south - it remains a symbol of the enduring adventurer's spirit.

node.name: [Foyer]
node.description: Subdued lighting illuminates the tasteful wooden paneling of the room while a bevy of overstuffed furniture provides comfortable seating for those contemplating weighty choices. Thick plush carpets in a myriad of hues cover the floor, almost totally obscuring the pale wooden planks of the flooring. Around the walls, a number of colored archways contain magical portals that, when open, allow access to the prize rooms beyond. A large set of double doors allows access to rooms devoted to dispenser activities while a round opening leads to the area devoted to workshops for alterations.

node.name: [Free Range Goods!, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel stand and a steel cart sit on the plain floor, with a steel bin placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A lunat rack hangs on the plain walls.

node.name: [From Here To Antiquity, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oak worktable sits on the lightly worn pearwood floor, with a deep packing crate padded with straw placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and muddy tracks smear across the floor. Some oak shelves hangs on the silk-covered walls. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and small white cobwebs obscure the corners.

node.name: [Galune's Gadgets, Sales Floor]
node.description: A simple steel sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak table and an oaken table sit on the oaken floor, with a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and a scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor. A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Galune's Gadgets, Sales Floor]
node.description: A simple steel sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. node.name: [Gate to Hibarnhvidar]
node.description: Nestled against a steep incline, a massive stone gate stands between the road proper and the city of Hibarnhvidar. Slight movement can be seen high atop the platforms that flank the gate's entrance. Carefully laid stonework provides a broad area just before the gate, and narrows into the path leading away from the city. Brushed and smoothed, the stones are evenly spaced, all traces of weed or loose gravel removed. A multi-pointed star marks the stone at the center of the entryway.

node.name: [General Dokora, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned.

node.name: [General Dokora, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned.

node.name: [Glimmering Goodies Galore, Sales Floor]
node.description: A mistglass-topped fruitwood sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass mantle and a black oak rack hang on the tawny gold-papered walls dotted with black diamonds, with a black oak dresser and a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. A black oak worktable sits alone on the gold-veined black marble floor.

node.name: [Glimmering Goodies Galore, Sales Floor]
node.description: A mistglass-topped fruitwood sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak worktable sits alone on the gold-veined black marble floor.

node.name: [Gnara's Tiny Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter inset with brilliantly hued gems sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. Some black oak shelves hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a black oak bar and a black oak armoir along the edges of the room. A black oak stand sits on the oaken floor, with a black oak chest placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Gnara's Tiny Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter inset with brilliantly hued gems sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.
