A black oak stand sits on the oaken floor, with a black oak chest placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

node.name: [Gnome Depot, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and an ironwood table sit on the lunat floor, with a granite trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and muddy tracks smear across the floor. A steel rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with an oak cabinet along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Gnome Depot, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood table and an oaken table sit on the lunat floor, with a granite trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Muddy tracks smear across the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A steel rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with an oak cabinet along the edges of the room. Dust has collected in the corners, and small piles of garbage litter the floor.

node.name: [Golden Grain Fields, Main Road]
node.description: The fields to the south begin to thin, accomodating for the road as it widens for increasing travel. On the horizon in the same direction, a shimmering crystal city waits astride a sparkling blue lake. On the other, northern horizon, the shadows of dark mountains loom hungrily over the fields that languish below them.

node.name: [Golden Grain Fields, Dusky Path]
node.description: A small chipmunk lounges on a cracked wooden fence, happily munching on the fruit of some poor farmer's hard labors. The shadow of a homesteading lurks over the rippling fields of grain to the west.

node.name: [Golden Grain Fields, Dusky Path]
node.description: The fields that surround the road seem to stretch on forever, bright burnished wheat swaying gently to the cadence of a slight breeze. The wide expanse of sky stretches far over the shimmering grains of the farmland.

node.name: [Golden Grain Fields, The Well]
node.description: A stone well rises from the earth beside the road, its rock surface polished, the rope and gears in prime condition. A young Elothean girl struggles with a heavy bucket of water, smiling at you through her disheveled golden locks.

node.name: [Golden Grain Fields]
node.description: Workers swing long, sharp scythes back and forth, slicing through the dense gold of the fields. Swift hands bundle the shafts of grain, laying them aside in tall piles.

node.name: [Gray Market, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and a black oak workbench sit on the bare floor, with a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [Gray Market, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and a black oak workbench sit on the bare floor, with a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [Grisgonda's Gems and Jewels]
node.description: As you step into the room, your feet sink into plush carpets. The walls are set with numerous locked display cases. A well-dressed guard gives you a polite visual once over and steps aside so you may enter. Gems of every sort and size, from slivers of plain looking crystal to a massive heart-shaped gem the size of a Gor'Tog's fist are displayed. Grisgonda herself sits at a plain black marble desk with a bright lamp upon it inspecting gems that have been brought in for sale by other adventurers.

node.name: [Guilty Treasures, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the granite floor, with a black oak case and a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A glass cabinet stands against the granite walls. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Guilty Treasures, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits on the granite floor, with a black oak case and a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A glass cabinet stands against the granite walls. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, East Park]
node.description: The Raven Gate, with its famed obsidian statues on either side, opens from Hibarnhvidar into the city's East Park, a lush alpine valley just outside the city wall. More like a meadow than the usual hovels and lean-tos that clutter the skirts of a big town, the verdant fields often attract residents to gather flowers or herbs.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, East Park]
node.description: To the west, the road leads down to a huge gate in a high wall. On either side of the gate tower statues of black ravens, impressive even at this distance. To the east, the road runs upward through the fields that lie on the lower slope of a high range of mountains.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, East Park]
node.description: A pleasant, park-like field lies along the road, covered with thick meadow grass and here and there dotted with pines and hemlocks surrounded by mountain laurel and rhododendron. The dark color of the evergreens blends almost unnoticeably into the cliffs to the south.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, East Park]
node.description: In a gentle decline westward to a walled city, the road passes through a valley lush with evergreen shrubs and trees. To the northeast, it switches back and forth several times as it climbs into the mountains.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The High Meadow]
node.description: For those who like bracing air, the smell of heather, and a constant wind fluttering the grass, this meadow is the place to be. The road descends to the southwest but runs south along a hillside clearing until it disappears into the pines on the mountainside.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Wooded Slope]
node.description: The road runs through a dense evergreen forest, following the steep incline of the mountainside with hardly a furlong of level ground in its route. It bridges rivulets that rush downhill and winds around curves that edge past steep drops.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: A long, steeply inclined span of graveled road stretches between two very different locales. In the one direction, the road climbs to the top of the rocky eastern ridge, almost forbidding in its starkness; in the other, it winds through the lower-lying meadows and orchards in the valley to the west.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: To the southwest, the steep but wide road rises from a distant valley, climbing to a gate in a stone wall to the northeast. Behind the wall, a grey tower three or four stories high dominates the skyline.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: This spot just below the summit of the ridge commands sweeping views to the north, where a broad river runs far below, and to the east and southeast, where another range fills the horizon. A short distance up the hill is a gate in a stone wall; to the southeast, the road skirts the side of the western range to the valley far below.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: Nearing the summit, the road traverses its steepest grade in its passage along the mountainside. A stone parapet lines the valley side of the roadway, giving warning and some protection against a misstep. Iron eyebolts have been driven into the cliff face, spaced about a furlong apart, for wagons that need to be secured while the team is changed or repairs are made.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: A spate of water roars down the mountainside with deafening noise and drenching mist, rushing under a stone bridge that carries the road across its path. A high brick parapet on the side toward the cataract screens the roadbed from the worst of the spray.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: For a stretch of several hundred yards the road widens, taking advantage of a natural ledge. The area offers unobstructed views of the roadway for a good distance up and down the slope, and the level ground allows caravans or wagons going in opposite directions to pass in safety.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: A rocky spur thrusts out from the face of the western range, and the road bends sharply around it, commanding sweeping views to the north, east, and south. At the valley side of the highway stands a telescope in a small paved area with a stone parapet.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: At one spot along the way, nature has provided one of her surprises -- fractures in the rock have divided the cliff wall into several nearly equal panels with smooth surfaces. And passersby have taken advantage of the oddity to use the panels as their tablets on which to address the world.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: The highway takes a sharp bend, turning in a sweeping curve along the almost vertical wall of the mountainside. A landslide in the past must have torn the road from its former path, requiring the hard labor of cutting away the hillside to reroute the road around the gap.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: The road lies along the side of the western range, passing from sight at times as it follows the contours of the hillside.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: A high valley spotted with wildflowers lies between two lines of mountain peaks. Across a ford to the southeast, the entrance to the underground highway beckons, but the view to the northwest awes rather than welcomes: a road twists and bends up the western range, switching back and forth and looking impossibly steep. As it dwindles from sight, high and far away, one can understand why it's called "The Sky Road".

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Stember's Ford]
node.description: A shallow ford crosses a small stream running north down the valley. A wide road leads from it to Sang Munar, the entrance to the tunnel beneath the eastern mountains. To the northwest, the road crosses the valley to the foot of the western mountain range.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Sang Munar]
node.description: The great gates of Sang Munar are set in a steep, wooded slope rising from the valley floor like the entrance to a dragon's treasure vault. They mark the west portal of the Road Beneath the Mountain, the underground link on the highway between Ain Ghazal and Hibarnhvidar.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Aws Munar]
node.description: The great gates of Aws Munar, entrance to the Road Beneath the Mountain, are set at an angle into a high cliff. Hammered bronze plates cover their surface with panels showing scenes of Dwarven kings and heroes. Majestic in size and massive in construction, they completely seal the tunnel mouth when closed. When open, they keep eternal watch on the road winding downhill to the northeast.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Himineldar Shel to Ain Ghazal]
node.description: Steep, high walls on each side reduce the view overhead to a narrow strip of sky, and the gradual curve of the defile blocks off the view very far ahead or behind. The excavation is an engineering feat, and given the potential of the cut for an avalanche, a defensive asset.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, Himineldar Shel to Ain Ghazal]
node.description: The Dwarven road, smoothly cobbled, well drained and in good repair, marches through, around and over the knees of the mountains to the west. They rise rank on jagged rank, and the road points straight to their heart.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, East Park]
node.description: A meadow slopes gently to the north, then ends abruptly in a sheer drop of hundreds of feet. An iron railing keeps the unwary from falling but does not obscure the view. Far below, the Segoltha River rolls along, and the lands north of it stretch to a far horizon in a landscape surpassing those of even the most talented painter. One can see why a picnic table and benches have been placed here.

node.name: [Haalikshal Highway, The Sky Road]
node.description: A spate of water roars down the mountainside with deafening noise and drenching mist, rushing under a stone bridge that carries the road across its path. A high brick parapet on the side toward the cataract screens the roadbed from the worst of the spray.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Terminus]
node.description: A sense of quiet and peace dominates the area, though birdsongs filter in from all directions. The narrow dirt road that began as a thriving thoroughfare far to the south meets a wall of foliage and dwindles off further into the woods as a faint trail.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Clusters of hosta form a border at the edge of the thicker underbrush. Their wide, deep green leaves are splotched with white, and in summer they send up tall shoots that bloom in decadent shades of purple and orange. Occasionally, they rustle with movement, and a small grey coney or brown chipmunk emerges to see what visitors have come to its domain.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The road is very narrow and uneven here, the forest leaning in from the sides and the craggy earth pushing up from below. Gnarled tree roots snake through the stone-clotted soil close to the surface. In places, they have been worn flat from years of accumulated foot traffic.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Thrusting up from the thick underbrush flanking the road, tall fingers of timeworn stone loom like phantoms that watch life pass by with the cold and detached gaze of eternity.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Amid the lushness of the evergreen forest stands the skeletal frame of a dead bristlecone pine. The pine's bare branches knock and scrape against each other with each breath of wind, sending down a shower of splintered wood. The tree's dry, brittle bark clings to the trunk only in small ragged spots that are host to conferences of termites.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A break in the forest canopy reveals a broad patch of the daytime sky. Below it, a swath of grass marred by a few wagon tracks sprawls out where the sunlight is able to spill down to the ground. Along the edge of the roadway bordering the woods are wispy sprays of heather.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: To one side of the road grows a copse of dogwood, its pebbly bark and meandering growing habit distinct from its evergreen neighbors. In the springtime, the copse celebrates with vibrant pink and white flowers.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Tangles of vines twine through the understory and twist up tree trunks. Eventually, they cloak so much of a tree's greenery that its arboreal host browns and dies from lack of sunlight. The vines reach their leafy tendrils out across the roadway, seeking unwary travelers to trip.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The road bends around a massive basalt boulder clad in a monochrome palette of green lichen. Vines climb from out of the crowd of shrubs surrounding the base of the rock, as though the ground were trying in vain to reclaim its former tenant.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Long pine boughs reach down from above to brush the pates of the road's taller travelers. The wind plays in the branches and releases their clean, crisp scent. Occasionally, the trees' movement will liberate sap-sugared pinecones that fall to the ground with a dense "thud."

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The land dips down here in a small, damp valley where rainwater drains, and the dense woods keep it from evaporating too quickly. Mosses of all varieties thrive in the moisture, with thick blankets of it cloaking rocks and tree trunks. Patches of it spot the roadway, especially at the edges, making the ground slippery even for the sure-footed.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The evergreens flanking the thoroughfare are tall and straight with high crowns of thickly needled branches. Tight clusters of shiny-leaved azalea dot the understory amid sprawling groups of feathery fern.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The road is lonesome here, with few birds or other feral visitors. Diminutive blue flowers sprawl along the roadside and provide cheerful company in the warmer months, but in the winter there is only the stark white pall of snow playing counterpoint to the deep shadows of the woods.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Boar Clan Bridge]
node.description: Meeting the road at a right angle, a moss-clad stone bridge leads over a shallow chasm through which a thin creek flows. The road narrows substantially as it continues to the northeast, becoming little more than a path and showing far fewer signs of passage than the wider, well-trodden section leading southeast.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The reek of skunk cabbage wafts from a clump of thick leaves growing at the edge of a tiny creek that trickles from the north. From a distance, the smell isn't very strong, but when the leaves are bruised, crushed, or otherwise damaged, they release an intense odor that attracts insects and may cause eyes to water.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Far from large cities or towns, animals in this forest have little fear of passersby. Here and there, one can see deer browsing shoots of grass unconcernedly or a hare twitching its nose in curiosity. A sound in the distance is more likely to be the growl of a prowling bear than a hammer striking an anvil.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A fresh scent of pine greets one's nostrils upon passing through these dense woods. The air in this unspoiled region is clean, though often brisk, and there is seldom a sound other than those made by animals, birds, the wind, or cones crunching underfoot.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Situated at the peak of its steady, gradual climb from the Biiskbowr River, the land is relatively level here but begins to descend to the southeast. A ring of firs circles a small clearing, which houses a stone bench upon which weary travelers can rest.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The roadway cuts its way through the woods, continuing its gradual climb. Alongside it is a peculiar stairway that appears to lead just down the road a bit. Near the head of the stairs is a roundish rock with a bit of paint on it.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Although there is packed dirt sufficiently wide to accommodate a caravan proceeding smoothly up the slope to the northwest, next to it there is a rough log stairway that leads the same way. The reason for this is not apparent. Perhaps someone was bored.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The road appears to be blocked by a clump of cedars; however, it merely loops around to either side. Evidently, the Gor'Togs in the region were unwilling to cut the fragrant trees down, which they prize because "they smell nice."

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A cacophony of bird calls echoes down from the trees, where raucous jays bully wrens and sparrows, and warblers sing, oblivious to the fracases. Flashes of color peek through the greenery periodically as bright tanagers flit among the tops of the firs and spruces.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Stones battle tenacious roots for supremacy as the land climbs northward. The evergreens of the forest persist here, but the mountains that rise to the east make their presence known.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A wooden signpost, bearing two carved arms pointing in opposite directions, is planted solidly in the ground by the side of the road. Puffs of dust are kicked up as travelers pass over the crumbly surface of crushed stone mixed with dried pine needles.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A jagged ridge rises to the east as the road climbs northward. The trees give way to chunks of stone as they approach the edge. As it passes, the road leans slightly away to the west as if it were leery of a fall.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A clump of firs stands at the top of a short rise. One tree in particular is marked with a yellow blaze, perhaps put there by one of the local trackers. Nearby is a pair of flat-topped stumps, cut off at an ideal height for them to serve as stools.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: From far above the treetops, an occasional hawk sounds its harsh cry as it soars down from the northern heights. The undergrowth rustles as small land-bound creatures scurry for cover.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A small pool with vegetation floating on its surface is situated within sight of the road. Varied hoof and paw prints lead up to the water's edge, suggesting that the local fauna come here often to drink. On the far side, there are occasional stirrings and flashes of movement from creatures too wary of travelers to come out into the open.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Tiny pale blue and white wildflowers dot the roadside, poking intrepidly between fallen pine needles. A fringe of small mushrooms circles a tall larch. Sheltered beneath the tree's branches is a flat, moss-covered rock, which looks to be an ideal location for a summer picnic.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: As it winds its way upward, the roadway crosses over slabs of rock, which serve as a reminder that, although the region is forested, it also abuts a mountain range. The remains of a small campfire can be seen on one such piece of stone, a handy spot on which to cook, devoid of flammable vegetation.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: An enormous spruce lies fallen across the packed-dirt road. In what must have been a heroic effort, some hardy soul has chopped a slice several feet wide through it. Although it looks to be a tight squeeze for a caravan, passage is once again possible.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: A spiky canopy shelters the lush forest, seemingly enforcing a hush upon all within it. Even the insects feasting upon the remains of a rotten tree trunk observe a certain degree of decorum, and the occasional snap of a twig caused by some passing animal has a curious muted quality.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: Downhill to the southeast, the gurgle of the Biiskbowr River, or as the local Gor'Togs call it, "The Wet River," can be heard. That sound seems to wrap a soft blanket around the area, rendering it otherwise silent save for a barely-heard birdsong every now and then.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The packed earth underfoot bears a bit of moisture, making it soft enough that many of the fallen pine needles have been stamped into it so that they have become more than merely a covering but rather a part of the road itself. On this green carpet, even heavy boots and hooves pass as quietly as slippers.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Dense Forest]
node.description: The evergreens begin to close in again as the road marches northward away from Archer's Ford and the river to the southeast. A rush of water splashing over stones is audible in the distance.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Riverbank]
node.description: A wide, smooth portion of road leads down to the northern bank of the Biiskbowr, which flows at a stately pace just to the southeast. The tracks from numerous wheels, hooves and boots indicate that much of the local traffic passes this way.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Archer's Ford]
node.description: Occasional small twigs and pine needles float lazily toward the southwest, indicating the river's direction of passage. Shallow enough that one can see one's own feet on the bottom in the crystal clear water, this is an ideal spot at which to make a crossing. Some of the broad, tall trees that crowd nearby are riddled with ancient arrows, giving a hint to the origin of the name, "Archer's Ford."

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Archer's Ford]
node.description: Even toward the center of the river, the water is shallow enough to remain below the heads of the shorter races. A combination of silt, twigs, and stone makes the bottom a tad slippery but still navigable.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Archer's Ford]
node.description: Jutting just a bit above the surface, a partially submerged tree causes the flow to split and go around either side. Away from the banks, the river is beyond the reach of the forest's green canopy, leaving a clear opening to the sky.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Archer's Ford]
node.description: Burbling softly, the river flows placidly on its leisurely journey to the southwest. Fallen debris from the overhanging greenery cushions the flat rocks beneath the surface, making this shallow section a promising choice for a crossing.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Riverbank]
node.description: Flowing gently at this point, the Biiskbowr River meanders down from the Journelai Range to the east, eventually emptying into the multi-armed Sawstwar Lake. The trees seem to have been trimmed back from the road sometime in the past, leaving a wide staging area for a group crossing.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Sloping down toward the north, the ground is a mixture of damp moss and stone with a smattering of pine needles on top. The trees to either side seem a trifle further apart than they do to the south.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Muddy patches make the footing somewhat slippery as the road inclines slightly on its way toward the nearby river. A few small sticks caked with dirt lean against an old tree stump, which appears to be a popular place for travelers to rest and clean their boots.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Lying a bit lower than the land to either side, the hard-packed dirt that passes for paved road has slowly become a morass of black goop. Ruts of varying description run at odd angles, indicating many a wagon has been caught unaware of the depth of the quagmire. Black bugs of various sizes swarm up into the air or scurry off into the underbrush with alarming regularity.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: An upended tree rests on the surrounding foliage, parallel to the forest floor. Bits of grass and soil surround the exposed roots, and the hollow beneath appears to have been usurped as home to a burrowing animal.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The road skirts the edge of a hillside with a faint path splitting off to trail down the slope. A deep rut in the road at the fork looks as if a wagon may have turned around in the rain.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Majestic pines have deposited their needles over this area, spreading it with a pungent cloak. Pebbles, pushed off to the sides, blend with the green and brown covering to mask the road's boundaries. Beneath the carpet of needles lie small, abrupt gradients that can trip unwary travelers.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A multitude of branches form a thick canopy that envelops the road, giving it a close, protected ambience. The limbs, thickly covered with lush needles, interlock like praying hands.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Interspersed between the trees are stacks of rocks and excavations that give the land a pimpled appearance. The piles appear orderly, as if someone had a purpose in mind at the time they did the digging. A few holes encroach upon the road, presenting a tripping hazard for the unwary.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Heavy foliage surrounds the road and creates the illusion of impediments as it curves slightly. To the northeast, it appears to dead-end at a group of tree trunks, and the southwest appears blocked by pines as it angles to the horizon.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Terrain changes are subtle, but the foliage and ground cover are a more varied mix of pine and the local Ke'nag tree. A sparse cover of fallen needles is interspersed with straggly grass. Distant enough from the edge of a nearby cliff to ensure the integrity of the surface in foul weather, the road consists of packed dirt and vegetation.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Pungent pine needles form a thick carpet that freshens the air with fragrance while muffling all sounds to a dull crunch. A venerable pine that has survived years of buffeting winds spreads its two remaining branches in an encompassing embrace around a much younger tree.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The air hangs heavily, and the only noise is that of nature pursuing its business of life and death. A distant rustle in the pines could be a forest denizen or merely a pinecone as it comes to rest on the well-padded ground.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Bare, stony patches interrupt the green expanse of the forest here and there as the foothills of the Journelai Range encroach on the soft tranquility of the evergreens.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Cresting a short hill, the road curls around a granite tor to the east. The trees nearby seem to shy away from the rock as if it might reach out and crush them.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The site of a many years old lightning strike can be seen to the east. Dark green moss crawls over the edge of a deep gash in the stony forest floor. Mangled trees, a few still resolutely clinging to life, protrude at awkward angles from the ground near the opening.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Gaps in the greenery cause alternating patches of light and shadow along the way. The harsh calls of raptors interrupt the silence periodically as they glide above, searching for prey.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Sparse clusters of pine and spruce line the way to either side. Jagged chunks of rock jut among the needles lining the path as the mountains begin to encroach upon the peaceful woods.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, A Clearing]
node.description: There is a small clearing among the trees here. At its center is a simple grey pedestal upon which stand marble figures of a Dwarf and a Gor'Tog, their hands clasped in friendship. A small bronze plaque is mounted at its base.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The woods are interrupted by a huge boulder, forcing the road to veer to the west on its way southward. Scattered elsewhere along the ground are small chunks of rock, possibly pieces that broke off when the huge stone fell.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Chunks of rock are interspersed among the moss and pine needles. Trees begin to give way to stone among the foothills of the mountains to the east.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A boulder, perhaps dislodged from the mountains to the east, blocks off passage on the eastern side, where there are traces of what appears to be an old path. A more freshly blazed passage goes around it to the other side, providing continued smooth travel for those not adept at rock climbing.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A layer of pine needles lies fallen from the firs on either side of the road. Passage is nearly silent except for the occasional crunch of a breaking twig under foot, hoof, or wheel.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Many of the trees here have the bark stripped away from the trunks near ground level. Now and then, a rustling can be heard from deeper in the woods. It seems likely that some gnawing creatures live nearby.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: Intermittent breezes blow across the path as the road goes over a small hill. The trees are somewhat sparser here, leaving more chance of exposure to the elements.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A bald spot in the springy forest floor of moss and evergreen needles has become moist enough to turn to mud, making the going a bit slippery. The divots here and there may indicate awkward landings by the unwary.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: There is a wide ditch in the middle of the road. Several heavy wooden planks have been placed across it to allow passage, but they seem a bit wobbly.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The trees are particularly dense in the part of the woods. One large pine near the roadway's edge is apparently home to a woodpecker, based on the intermittent hammering sounds coming from it.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A layer of moss along the road adds spring to the traveler's steps and muffles the sounds of footfalls. Beneath the canopy of trees veiling the area, an almost palpable sense of peace seems to hover in the air, enticing many a sojourner to tarry in this green sanctuary.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: A bed of pine needles cushions the forest floor on either side of the packed dirt road. Little can be heard save for the rush of the river as it passes to the south.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Through the Forest]
node.description: The foothills of the Himeneldar Shel Mountains fade into a patchy forest on this side of the Segoltha. Off to the south, the Chedik Bridge, with the city and mountains beyond it, is still visible through gaps in the trees.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, North River Bank]
node.description: The impressive Chedik bridge spans the Segoltha to the south, rising in a sturdy granite arch above the rapids. To the north, the Dwarven-laid paving stones end abruptly, and the road becomes packed dirt, still navigable but more subject to the whims of nature.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Chedik Bridge]
node.description: At this end of the span, there is little sense of being in an urban region. The road to the north leads into a densely wooded area, while the view to south is that of the mountains only, with Hibarnhvidar hidden behind the rise of the bridge's surface. Upon reaching the riverbank, the paving stones fade to dirt, perhaps signaling the boundary of Dwarven influence on the land.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Chedik Bridge]
node.description: Beginning its downward slope to the north, the bridge is bracketed by a pair of impressive granite towers, twins to those on the south side. Serving as stanchions, which, along with the heavy iron chains, support this marvel of Dwarven engineering, they rise up from the Segoltha, seemingly immune to the ravages of nature. A heavy steel door is set into each of them, although the rust on the locks and hinges suggests that they have not seen any use in quite a while.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Chedik Bridge]
node.description: Cresting above the thundering rapids, the bridge affords the traveler a panoramic vista of the entire region. To the north, the forests of northern Forfedhdar extend as far as the eye can see. Southward lies the great walled city of Hibarnhvidar, backed by the mountains rising in the distance. The river rushes onward to the west, where it empties into the many-armed Sawstwar Lake.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Chedik Bridge]
node.description: The bridge arcs upward to the north, flanked on either side by massive granite towers to which the bridge is anchored by thick iron chains. Heavy steel doors lead into the huge structures, although they look anything but inviting. Looking to the south, one can see Hibarnhvidar's water wheel, endlessly turning in the mighty Segoltha.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Chedik Bridge]
node.description: The stone paving continues, grading slightly upward as it meshes nearly seamlessly into the beginning of the Chedik Bridge, which exhibits the same high standard of Dwarven craftsmanship as the road that approaches it. Below, rapids thunder against jagged rocks protruding from the river, providing a severe hazard to travel by water but an excellent source of power for the nearby city. Gazing southward, one can see the walls of Hibarnhvidar looming against the backdrop of the mountains in the distance.

node.name: [Hawstkaal Road, Approach to Hibarnhvidar]
node.description: A steady stream of visitors tromps to and from Hibarnhvidar's Northwest Gate just to the south. Belying the diminutive stature of its Dwarven builders, the hulking portal of iron and stone makes even the Gor'Togs among the pedestrians seem small as they pass beneath its arch. The rush of the nearby Segoltha River mutes the hubbub of feet, hooves, and wheels passing alone the stone road.

zone.name: Help! Allye Made Me Sell Stuff

node.name: [Help! Allye Made Me Sell Stuff, Sales Floor]
node.description: A crescent-shaped sales counter lined with burgundy velvet sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A pale marble table with white gold corner caps sits on the interlocking wooden parquet floor, with an angled silver chest lined with plush black velvet and a wire-frame mannequin accented with strips of kertig placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners. A silver-gilt cabinet with frosted glass door panels stands against the burgundy-papered walls with fanciful scrollwork. The shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor, and small piles of garbage litter the floor.

node.name: [Help! Allye Made Me Sell Stuff, Sales Floor]
node.description: A crescent-shaped sales counter lined with burgundy velvet sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A pale marble table with white gold corner caps sits on the interlocking wooden parquet floor, with an angled silver chest lined with plush black velvet and a wire-frame mannequin accented with strips of kertig placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners, and a scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor. A silver-gilt cabinet with frosted glass door panels stands against the burgundy-papered walls with fanciful scrollwork. The shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor, and small piles of garbage litter the floor.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Stark ironwood trees form a nearly impenetrable barrier around this small clearing, dark gaps open at each end to allow travelers to pass from the trade road to the Seord Kerwaith. A squat inn sits just off of the narrow beaten path. Built with thick timbers exposed against whitewashed walls, the two-story building appears rugged enough to withstand even the harshest of Forfedhdarian winters.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Dense forest closes in on either side of the path, creating the dimness of twilight no matter how bright the sun above the trees. The rustle of animals can be heard in the distance, and the dark flash of the occasional leaping deer is the only visible sign of life.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Delicate and pale, a cluster of white snowdrops blooms in the hollow of a rotten log lying alongside the path. The fallen tree's death seems to have caused the only spot of sky visible here, allowing a ray of sunshine to hit the fragile flowers.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Closing oppressively around the rocky path, overhanging pine branches provide a wake-up call to wanderers not paying attention to the landscape. Overhead, birds twitter unseen.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Echoing through the leafy woods, the howl of the wind coming down the mountain is an ever-present reminder of the harsher, colder conditions to the south. Pine needles cushion the path underfoot, fallen from the abundance of conifers that stretch towards the sky.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: A steep stretch of the path joins the lower route to the west with the rugged ascent across Himineldar Shel. Craggy stone juts from between stalks of hardy scrub grass, the large chunks of granite reminiscent of blocks of black ice. The forest thins here, only sparse adventurous pine trees sprouting further up, leaving their hardwood brethren behind.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Sparse patches of brambles dot the steep path which winds its way up the stony mountainside. The rare patch of dirt reveals the prints of some kind of large feline.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Chill winds howl constantly along the mountain road. Every now and then, a stray flurry of snowflakes swirls down the path from a sudden gust of wind somewhere upwards.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Here and there a fragile snowdrop pokes its head up through the thin layer of frost that covers everything from this part of the mountain up. Among the delicate flowers is a single frostbane bush, its dull burgundy hue bright against the whiteness of the landscape.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Footprints in the snow are barely discernible, though quite a few congregate in the area of a small cave mouth nearby. Animal bones, the same bland white as their surroundings, lie scattered about, only the dull stain of blood at the ends ruining their camouflage.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Short and scraggly, a cluster of pine trees huddles together like bent old men standing side by side for warmth. Beneath the largest conifer lie the shredded remains of a rough sackcloth lean-to, now covered by a thin layer of dirty ice and completely unusable.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Amid the rocky crags and icy snowdrifts is a small area encircled by chunks of stone, the space just large enough for a Dwarf to lie down in. At the fore is a small monument of crossed pickaxes, their blades dull and rusted and handles lashed together with heavy twine. Placed just below it is a crude ice sculpture of a raven, with some black substance mixed into the water before freezing to give it a dusky hue.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Stretching out in all directions, the craggy mountainside's icy and monotonous pallor is in stark contrast to the view of Forfedhdar it presents from here. A thin plume of smoke is barely visible from an inn at the mountain's northern foot, settled in the only visible clearing amidst the dense forest below.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: A gentle dusting of snow, like finely sifted powdered sugar, covers the surrounding landscape, growing in density towards the twisted summit of the Himineldar Shel. Stooped trees jut randomly from the snowy ground underfoot, their partially bare canopies swaying in the chill breeze.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The steeply angled, stone-strewn road weaves between several large boulders protruding from the snow. Icy wind, speeding down the rough slope of the mountain, seems to cut into any exposed flesh like an invisible blade, bringing with it a dull howl.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The roadway narrows slightly as it hugs the steep exterior of the mountain, its outer edge overlooking the sheer rock wall falling far below. A few lifeless plants and miniature trees cling precariously to the slopes, their tangled roots weaving between the shallow cracks in the partially frozen facade.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The roadway weaves along the mountainside, cutting a narrow swath into the rock face. Far below, dagger-like rocks jut from a grey stone basin midway down the sheer eastern face of the Himineldar Shel, their icy surfaces glistening in the sunlight.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Glistening icicles dangle from countless narrow ledges hanging from the sheer rock face above, peeping out from beneath the densely packed snow. The air is filled with the howl of the deathly chill wind as it sweeps over weathered stone, spinning shimmering flakes snow about in a hurricane of white.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Curious shapes rise from the densely packed snow, concealing whatever might be lurking beneath the shifting sea of pristine white crystals. The walkway cuts a narrow path into the Halfling-high snow, and the track's shoulders are covered in a thin layer of crystal-clear ice.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: As if rolling out a pristine white welcome mat, the summit of the Himineldar Shel spirals skyward to the west. Howling blasts of bone-chilling wind curl downward from the peak of the mountain to sweep though the area, sending crystals of ice and snow dancing across the frozen landscape.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Several paces off the frozen pathway, a clawed ice-covered hand protrudes from somewhere beneath the snow, having paid the ultimate price for straying from the path formerly laid before the poor soul. The landscape is a sea of snow and ice, the shimmering surface rolling along the uneven ground.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The restless assault of the elements sweeps across the frozen landscape with an almost malevolent intelligence, as if driven to consume all living beings upon the icy slopes. Howling mountain winds devour all other sounds with a brutal hunger, whipping across the craggy stone that protrudes from the smooth surface of snow.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Ice monoliths tower above the landscape, refracting the available light like mammoth prisms and casting rainbows of color upon the pristine driven snow. Several crates and the shattered remnants of a gilded caravan rest in a heap alongside the manmade pathway cut into the shifting snow drifts, carelessly discarded in an attempt to escape the bitter cold elements of the Himineldar Shel.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Rising amidst the shifting mass of snow and ice, a jagged rock wall ascends to the foot of the twisted pinnacle that marks the summit of the mountain. In the lee of the rock facade in a small niche carved out by the elements, a stunted sapling sits within a thick cocoon of white ice. A gentle rain of shimmering snow crystals tail downward from the ledge high above, swirling along upon the bitterly cold wind.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Covered in ice, a narrow trail hugs the sheer rock face as it winds through the mountains. Fierce winds punish the pass with their incessant fury, a timeless war of element against element. Blinding snow storms strike with little warning throughout the region.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Distant mountains loom along the horizon, their peaks lost in swirling clouds of windblown snow and ice crystals. The monotonous landscape, consisting of unbroken, blinding white snow fields with scattered brown or grey rocky outcroppings, does little to stir the imagination. Ascending and descending, each successive mountain lulls the traveler into a false sense of security. It is when the mind is weakest that nature strikes with unbridled fury, be it blizzard, avalanche or the slip of the foot.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Incessant storms rage throughout this region, the bitter cold winds a constant companion to travelers. Blinding clouds of snow race across the slopes, covering everything in an ever-increasing blanket of white. The awesome power of nature unleashed against the mountain's solid stone is spellbinding. Towering mountains dominate the landscape and stretch as far as the eye can see, an endless procession of white-capped peaks.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Fractured rocks, the shattered bones of the mountain, tell the tale of a recent slide and lie scattered about the trail. Larger splinters thrust up through the deep drifts, the dull greys and browns in stark contrast to the purity of the white snow pack. Howling winds rush down from the highest peaks, screaming through the pass with a banshee-like wail. Majestic snowcapped mountains stretch across the horizon with regal splendor, their beauty belying their cold-hearted truth.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Assaulted by an endless series of storms and brutal winds, the narrow trail slowly wends its way through the pass. Sheer rock walls rise on either side of the path. In the distant past a river raced through the tight confines of this gorge. The raging gales frequently dislodge large boulders from the cliffs above. With little warning these missiles plummet and shatter violently on impact with the bottom of the pass, showering the trail and snow drifts with debris.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Jagged cliffs rise on each side of the twisting trail, the rock walls channeling and strengthening the fierce winds that race through the gorge. Deep snow drifts, a constant presence through this region, cover the pass like the swells of a frozen sea. Splintered fragments of rock, remnants of past slides, litter the blanket of snow making for a hazardous journey. The crumbling stone and suffocating layer of white lend an eerie stillness to the pass broken only by the howling wind.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Majestic snowcapped peaks and an undisturbed blanket of snow are but a few of the treasures this region has to offer. Rugged mountains form a protective circle around a small plateau, sparing it from the harshest weather. In sharp contrast to the torturous winds and storms beyond, this sheltered spot is peaceful and serene. Snow crystals, blown aloft from the heights, float lazily through the still air. Their graceful flight lends a magical quality to the small fell.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Imposing rock walls rise above the narrow trail, their incredible height blocking the feeble light of day from reaching the bottom of the gorge. Water trickling down from a hidden spring freezes, forming hideous misshapen monstrosities that glare down upon the snowy passage. Howling winds rip through the pass dislodging the icy growths, sending the figures flying in an awkward dance before shattering at the bottom of the gorge.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Cataclysmic events shattered this mighty mountain, creating a basalt wall that rises high into the sky. A twisting trail, barely wide enough to walk along, hugs the sheer rock face overlooking a deep chasm that plunges into unseen depths. Raging winds race through the narrow gorge, assaulting the ears and mind with their high-pitched shriek.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Along the sheer walls that surround the roadway, thick sheets of ice cling to the rough stone beneath. Within it hang rocks, stones and various other debris, appearing to rest weightless in midair. Sharp gusts of wind sweep down the mountainside, pulling shards of ice from the face of the glacier to send them careening into the gorge far below.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The road curves sharply as it slides along the sheer walls of ice that coat the mountainside. Along the outer side of the path, a deep chasm sweeps downward to end in a gorge filled with dagger-like rock protrusions littered with the remnants of wood and bone. Rushing icy water spews down from a wide crack in the mountainside, the spray freezing instantly upon contact with the frigid air, making travel very hazardous.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Far below, a lush valley is visible, framed within jagged peaks of icy black stone. A gentle mist rises from the jungle as tropical birds sweep amongst the stone-grey canopies that push in close to a massive black spire set into the southeastern wall. The low babble of water reverberates off the icy walls of the mountainside, slowly slipping downward in semicircular beds of ice that follow the contours of the roadway.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Crystal fonts of spring water trickle from jagged crevices that streak across the stone facade of the Himineldar Shel, forming curious icy sculptures and giving the appearance of an enormous crystal fountain. From time to time, shards of ice or rock tumble from the treacherous cliffs above, landing in the gorge below with a resounding impact. The road tightly hugs the sheer cliffs as it cuts a pathway though the rugged landscape.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Rope Bridge]
node.description: The path slants along the rock face at a sharp angle and ends suddenly at a makeshift wooden bridge, reaching across the gaping maw of a chasm at a nearly vertical angle. Numerous trickles of crystal clear water sweep downward along the massive formations of ice, slipping quietly off the side of the chasm with a gentle gurgle. An opaque mist swirls around the swaying, ice-slick bridge, giving an oddly unreal quality to the rushing gurgle of unseen water in the chasm below.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Rope Bridge]
node.description: Spanning the massive gap over a curving canyon that follows the lower contours of the Himineldar Shel, the bridge sways hazardously in the swirling breeze sweeping upward from the raging river below. Massive icicles dangle from every surface of the rickety structure, occasionally snapping loose to tumble from sight. The landscape beyond is shrouded by a thick opaque mist, giving the air a nearly tangible presence.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Rope Bridge]
node.description: The path slants along the rock face at a sharp angle and ends suddenly at a makeshift wooden bridge, reaching across the gaping maw of a chasm at a nearly vertical angle. Numerous trickles of crystal clear water sweep downward along the massive formations of ice, slipping quietly off the side of the chasm with a gentle gurgle. An opaque mist swirls around the swaying, ice-slick bridge, giving an oddly unreal quality to the rushing gurgle of unseen water in the chasm below.

Howling winds rip through the pass dislodging the icy growths, sending the figures flying in an awkward dance before shattering at the bottom of the gorge.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Majestic snowcapped peaks and an undisturbed blanket of snow are but a few of the treasures this region has to offer. Rugged mountains form a protective circle around a small plateau, sparing it from the harshest weather. In sharp contrast to the torturous winds and storms beyond, this sheltered spot is peaceful and serene. Snow crystals, blown aloft from the heights, float lazily through the still air. Their graceful flight lends a magical quality to the small fell.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Jagged cliffs rise on each side of the twisting trail, the rock walls channeling and strengthening the fierce winds that race through the gorge. Deep snow drifts, a constant presence through this region, cover the pass like the swells of a frozen sea. Splintered fragments of rock, remnants of past slides, litter the blanket of snow making for a hazardous journey. The crumbling stone and suffocating layer of white lend an eerie stillness to the pass broken only by the howling wind.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Assaulted by an endless series of storms and brutal winds, the narrow trail slowly wends its way through the pass. Sheer rock walls rise on either side of the path. In the distant past a river raced through the tight confines of this gorge. The raging gales frequently dislodge large boulders from the cliffs above. With little warning these missiles plummet and shatter violently on impact with the bottom of the pass, showering the trail and snow drifts with debris.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Fractured rocks, the shattered bones of the mountain, tell the tale of a recent slide and lie scattered about the trail. Larger splinters thrust up through the deep drifts, the dull greys and browns in stark contrast to the purity of the white snow pack. Howling winds rush down from the highest peaks, screaming through the pass with a banshee-like wail. Majestic snowcapped mountains stretch across the horizon with regal splendor, their beauty belying their cold-hearted truth.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Incessant storms rage throughout this region, the bitter cold winds a constant companion to travelers. Blinding clouds of snow race across the slopes, covering everything in an ever-increasing blanket of white. The awesome power of nature unleashed against the mountain's solid stone is spellbinding. Towering mountains dominate the landscape and stretch as far as the eye can see, an endless procession of white-capped peaks.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Distant mountains loom along the horizon, their peaks lost in swirling clouds of windblown snow and ice crystals. The monotonous landscape, consisting of unbroken, blinding white snow fields with scattered brown or grey rocky outcroppings, does little to stir the imagination. Ascending and descending, each successive mountain lulls the traveler into a false sense of security. It is when the mind is weakest that nature strikes with unbridled fury, be it blizzard, avalanche or the slip of the foot.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Rope Bridge]
node.description: The path slants along the rock face at a sharp angle and ends suddenly at a makeshift wooden bridge, reaching across the gaping maw of a chasm at a nearly vertical angle. Numerous trickles of crystal clear water sweep downward along the massive formations of ice, slipping quietly off the side of the chasm with a gentle gurgle. An opaque mist swirls around the swaying, ice-slick bridge, giving an oddly unreal quality to the rushing gurgle of unseen water in the chasm below.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Crystal fonts of spring water trickle from jagged crevices that streak across the stone facade of the Himineldar Shel, forming curious icy sculptures and giving the appearance of an enormous crystal fountain. From time to time, shards of ice or rock tumble from the treacherous cliffs above, landing in the gorge below with a resounding impact. The road tightly hugs the sheer cliffs as it cuts a pathway though the rugged landscape.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Far below, a lush valley is visible, framed within jagged peaks of icy black stone. A gentle mist rises from the jungle as tropical birds sweep amongst the stone-grey canopies that push in close to a massive black spire set into the southeastern wall. The low babble of water reverberates off the icy walls of the mountainside, slowly slipping downward in semicircular beds of ice that follow the contours of the roadway.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: The road curves sharply as it slides along the sheer walls of ice that coat the mountainside. Along the outer side of the path, a deep chasm sweeps downward to end in a gorge filled with dagger-like rock protrusions littered with the remnants of wood and bone. Rushing icy water spews down from a wide crack in the mountainside, the spray freezing instantly upon contact with the frigid air, making travel very hazardous.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Along the sheer walls that surround the roadway, thick sheets of ice cling to the rough stone beneath. Within it hang rocks, stones and various other debris, appearing to rest weightless in midair. Sharp gusts of wind sweep down the mountainside, pulling shards of ice from the face of the glacier to send them careening into the gorge far below.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Cataclysmic events shattered this mighty mountain, creating a basalt wall that rises high into the sky. A twisting trail, barely wide enough to walk along, hugs the sheer rock face overlooking a deep chasm that plunges into unseen depths. Raging winds race through the narrow gorge, assaulting the ears and mind with their high-pitched shriek.

node.name: [Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]
node.description: Imposing rock walls rise above the narrow trail, their incredible height blocking the feeble light of day from reaching the bottom of the gorge. Water trickling down from a hidden spring freezes, forming hideous misshapen monstrosities that glare down upon the snowy passage. Howling winds rip through the pass dislodging the icy growths, sending the figures flying in an awkward dance before shattering at the bottom of the gorge.

node.name: [Hoarder's Corner, Sales Floor]
node.description: A gold-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A knotted flax cargo net hangs on the silver-veined black marble walls, with a net-wrapped driftwood trunk with rusted hinges and a cherrywood shelf with carved finials along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls. A steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins and a velvet-covered display sit on the silver-veined black marble floor. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: A mature felenok pine reaches majestically skyward and seems to grasp the sun in its outstretched limbs. Large, golden cones burden the ends of each branch, making them arc slightly downward. Few felenok seeds survive to fulfill their purpose, as they are sweet to the palate of local squirrels that eagerly pry them from their cones before they drop to the ground.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: Twin maple seedlings grow in a depression atop a very large basalt boulder. A passing bird must have deposited the seeds, as there are no other maple trees in the glade. Birds enjoy the rock because the shallow wells in its surface hold water high enough from the ground that they can drink and bathe here without being menaced by the glade's larger inhabitants.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: Soft pillows of bright green moss cling to the gnarled roots of some yews grouped on a low rise. Between the trees, small piles of snow held in hollows formed by the roots melt slowly, providing a constant trickle to moisten the bark on which the moss thrives.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: A white-breasted nuthatch sitting in an overhead bough aggressively calls its mate with a nasal "ank-ank-ank" sound. After a few calls, an answer comes in a shrill "kee-kee" from another limb. Several other avian conversations begin, each with its own pitch, rhythm and emotion. Rarely is there a moment of complete silence.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: A dead pine's skeletal branches knock together in the wind, and the dry rapping noises travel down the limbs into the trunk, sounding like a heart beating somewhere deep within. The coarse, black bark clings to the weather-silvered tree only in ragged patches that crumble off easily, and in the crook of a low branch, the wood bears the lacy scars of a termite infestation.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: Beneath many of the shrubs and low tree branches are large saucer-shaped depressions. The leaf-lined hollows evidence the forest's boar population. In the day, the nests are filled with several boars piled together in sleep, but in the evening, all the nests are empty as entire drifts of boars roam the glade.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: A patch of green grows in this wide clearing amid the trees and pine needle-covered earth. Tiny yellow waiku flowers huddle in the grasses and clover, their petals closed tightly against the sunlight. The flora surrounding the clearing is as varied as a patchwork shawl.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: The needle-strewn forest floor spreads out beneath a sky framed by spruce and pine boughs. Seasonal flowers sprawl in sunlit clearings while juniper and laurel shrubs enjoy the shade where patches of snow linger throughout the year.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Cragside]
node.description: Thick clusters of blueberry bushes amble along the edge of the crags and quiver with the movements of birds perched within. At dawn and twilight, when the sun's light is thinnest, small grey conies hop out from the shrubs in search of grasses and roots to augment their diet of berries. The river is barely visible as it wends through the banks far beyond the bushes and the stony descent.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: The thick, scaly bark of a nearby sikka tree secretes golden sap that wells in the cracks and crevices. Unlucky insects become entombed in the gooey traps.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: The trees of the forest grow tall and thin with branches that begin several stories overhead. Most trees have had their bark rubbed and gouged off about a Dwarf's height from the ground. Stuck into a thick thorn-covered fir is a long yellowed splinter of boar tusk.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: A weeping hemlock droops over a weathered lunat log to shelter a patch of spindly puffball mushrooms that grow tall and top-heavy so that they bend over slightly beneath the weight of their pale caps. From somewhere close comes the sound of grunting and something trundling through the underbrush.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: A stand of pale slender-trunked paper birches grows along a ridge to the northeast. Their bark is thin, white and smooth, separating into diaphanous strips that curl back from the trunk. Skinny saplings growing amid the taller elders are reddish-brown but share the same delicate pointed-oval leaves that turn golden in autumn.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Southern Tract]
node.description: A line of ashen birches looks ghostly pale against the darker pines that surround them, like the spirits of fallen trees floating amid the living. Their leafy limbs sway gracefully with each breath of wind and rustle a soft accompaniment to the river's song.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: Bristly spruce limbs cast filigree shadows that frolic over the ground as the trees sway in breezes scented with the clean smell of heather and pine. The trees stand far enough apart that their branches do not overlap, and scrubby bunches of grass peek through the thin layer of pine needles covering the ground between the trees' canopy.

node.name: [Hunter's Glade, Northern Tract]
node.description: Heather grows in wispy clumps between the widely spaced trees. Its feathery texture contrasts with the stiff and dark-leafed boxwood growing nearby, and it celebrates each thaw with blooming sprays of purple and lavender.

node.name: [Inabelle's Exotics, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel cart and a steel stand sit on the granite floor. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor, and a scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor. The oaken walls are unadorned. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [JAK'S Treasures, Sales Floor]

node.name: [Jep's Jems, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak rack hangs on the lunat walls, with a rough-hewn cabinet of pine boughs with cedar plank shelves along the edges of the room. A large horsefly buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Clearing]
node.description: The oppressive darkness of the canopy yields slightly, allowing a glimpse of the sky above. Patches of corpse moss carpet the ground, their black sporophytes giving off an odor of carrion. Strangled with ivy and lichen, a blighted elm struggles to grow amidst a ring of yellow death cap mushrooms.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Understory]
node.description: The faint path leading into the forest vanishes within the ghostly mist that snakes its way around gnarled and twisted tree trunks, concealing writhing and interlacing roots. Occasionally, a slender beam of sunlight manages to escape the prison of the canopy above, though it is quickly lost among tangled boughs and vines.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Old Growth]
node.description: Patiently waiting for a gap to form in the dense canopy, coniferous saplings like pines and larches grow in the shadow of towering mikkhalbamar and ironwood trees. Sinister whisperings rustle from tree to tree, punctuated by a baleful caw from the crows that watch from above.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Old Growth]
node.description: Bent limbs and twisted roots discourage haste, threatening to trip those who do not move carefully. Luminous eyes peer through the foliage, perhaps waiting for the foliage to ensnare a victim.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, The Ancient One]
node.description: At the center of a clearing, an ancient bristlecone pine holds court, its trunk gnarled and twisted. Its withered limbs reach up toward the heavens, forming a monstrous silhouette.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Old Growth]
node.description: Sundered by lightning, the splintered trunk of a once-proud black ironwood tree juts from the ground, threatening to impale anyone who trips in the darkness. The odors of decay and ozone mingle in the air.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Old Growth]
node.description: An immense spiderweb stretches between the gnarled branches of an old juniper tree, its gossamer threads nearly invisible in the twilight beneath the dense canopy. Now and again, the web twitches with the movements of its unseen architect.

node.name: [Kaal Utewg, Bog]
node.description: A fetid smell rises from a small bog, its surface black and murky. Drag marks in the mud lead deeper into the woods, the surrounding foliage dappled with drops of blood.

node.name: [Kaerna Village, By the Well]
node.description: The Northern Trade road runs like an arrow through the small town of Kaerna. Composed mostly of ramshackle daub and wattle houses, the most distinguishing feature of Kaerna is its inn, which looms protectively over the other, smaller establishments. Less a town and more a waystation than anything else, the tiny wooden-walled village hugs the road with a tenacious determination.

node.name: [Kaerna Village, Intersection]
node.description: The main activity of the town seems to be concentrated here where traders, villagers, and travellers from afar gather to exchange information or engage in a bit of bartering. Presiding over all of this is the Gilded Unicorn Inn, the largest building in the village as well as the best kept. Far from the bustle and turmoil of the big city, its doors are always open, a lantern or candle always lit.

node.name: [Kaerna Village, By the General Store]
node.description: A few residences huddle here, alternately shouldered up against the back of the Gilded Unicorn Inn and the sides of the general store. The store is squat but neat, its exterior newly whitewashed and a small garden carefully cultivated outside it.

node.name: [Kaldar Junk Is Elven Treasure, Sales Floor]
node.description: A gold-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oak stand sits on the gold-veined black marble floor, with a black oak bin placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Grime has collected along the walls, and small puddles of standing water litter the floor. A oak mantle hangs on the gold-veined black marble walls. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor.

Dust has collected in the corners, and a swarm of gnats buzzes about the room. Some oak shelves hangs on the oaken walls, with an oak cabinet along the edges of the room. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and small piles of garbage litter the floor.

node.name: [Khauskho's Wholesale, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A ironwood shelf hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room.

A large square table crafted from rich red cherrywood and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the silver-veined black marble floor. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the silver-veined black marble walls.

node.name: [Kiyora's Starlight Selections, Sales Floor]
node.description: A crescent-shaped sales counter lined with burgundy velvet sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. node.name: [Klausette Full Of Things, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter inset with brilliantly hued gems sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ornate smokewood chest and a glass table sit on the white-veined pink marble floor, with an ornate glass pedestal with carved sana'ati fae legs and a small glass jewelry box with vivid gems inset at each corner placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. An ironwood rack hangs on the soft purple stripe-papered walls. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners, and grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [Klausette Full Of Things, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter inset with brilliantly hued gems sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.
