node.name: [KLS Metalwork And Leather Goods, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak table sits on the granite floor, with a black oak trunk and a black oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. The granite walls are unadorned.

node.name: [KLS Metalwork And Leather Goods, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak table sits on the granite floor, with a black oak trunk and a black oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. The granite walls are unadorned. Small puddles of standing water litter the floor.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Foyer]
node.description: Column-ringed, this circular room has a high ceiling painted in birds, clouds and deep blue sky. A soft light is provided by oil lamps in bowls that are suspended in rings. Ornate, gilded chairs stand before a grey marble fireplace with a crackling fire. Across from the seating area, a large listings board hangs between two of the three arches providing access to the shop fronts.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Keep Room]
node.description: Placed centrally, a large and heavily varnished square mistwood case with a glass dome is the only piece of furniture in the room. Portraits in ornate frames line the two long walls with the Therengia standard on brass poles standing guard at each end of the room. Shoppers and merchants stop to gaze at the panorama before moving on to their business.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Dungeon Room]
node.description: Manacles and leg irons hang from the dark granite-colored walls. Low-set limestone tables with recesses carved into them are covered with heavy glass plates. A brazier stands ready in the middle of the room with dark, cold coals and a large bellow leaning against it. Oiled torches in heavy pewter sconces provide a flickering light and a haze of smoke near the ceiling.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Storage Area]
node.description: Large cabinets line all four walls, with plaques on each door pertaining to the various shops in the Hall. Heavy padlocks on steel chains keep them secure. A low cart on wheels stands vacant and ready to help transport the contents as each trader might need them. The thick oaken planks of the floor have been swept clear of all debris, but is marked in places where there might have been spills or falling objects.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Theatre Room]
node.description: Chairs in short rows are seated before a dais with a miniature stage set in a large box with a red velvet curtain hanging on the back. The bright colorful hat of a jester puppet peeks through, awaiting the return of its handler. Playbills from past performances of the Theren Theatre group are hung in simple frames. A large barrel filled with bags of popcorn is filled by an industrious staff member.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Rose Room]
node.description: Large crystal vases on cherrywood stands line the walls with two long rows of padded benches placed back to back down the center. Freshly cut roses of white, pink and deep red are carefully arranged in each vase, lending a heady scent to the room. Alert guards prevent curious children and lovesick young men escorting pretty young ladies from helping themselves to the flowers.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, World Room]
node.description: Tapestries embroidered with battle scenes with noble paladins, valiant archers and mages releasing lightning bolts and balls of fire against their enemies are displayed on all four walls. The floor is painted with an elaborate map of the five provinces of Elanthia that has been protected by many coats of clear varnish. Children stop to follow the trade routes that have been outlined in grey, wandering on tip-toe through mountain ranges and rushing rivers alike.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, The Back Room]
node.description: Compact and dark-paneled, the room is full of discarded furniture pushed together into all four corners. Mismatched paintings hang askew on the walls; a seascape, a faded portrait of a dark-haired woman and large oil of splashes of color that someone has sliced from corner to corner. People move quickly into the shops and out, not caring to spend time loitering in this dimly-lit area.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Warrior Room]
node.description: Central in the room, a life-sized carved wooden warhorse stands rearing on a woven burgundy runner outlined in brass stanchions with velvet covered ropes. The steed is fully bedecked in a suit of polished plate, tassels of gold threads hanging from its harness and a brass-riveted scabbard hanging beside the black leather saddle. Paintings of stallions in battle are hung above high-backed gilded chairs placed near the entrances to the various shops.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Food Plaza]
node.description: Leather-backed chairs and small tables in sets of two to four are arranged neatly inside a small wrought-iron partitioned area. Serving carts laded with food and drinks line the walls with staff ready to quickly wipe away all evidence of past partakers as customers and merchants stop for a small repast.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Children's Room]
node.description: The oak walls have been whitewashed and then painted with a fanciful woodland scene in bright colors. A young girl and boy watch from behind a large pine tree as animals gather peacefully around a sparkling stream as wisps dance in the air around them. An equal number of small stools in white and silver are placed on a large checkerboard painted onto the floor.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Tower Room]
node.description: Overlooking the plaza below, a handful of shopfronts are tucked into the recessed entryways of fanciful towers and spires that reach to the ceiling high above. Though merely decorative and designed with the plaza's aesthetic, the stonework is masterfully done and could no doubt withstand the tests of time and nature if they were completed structures. Colorful banners drape from each tower's face and are illuminated by fanciful dragon-headed sconces -- some clutching flickering torches and others glowing gaethzen orbs.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, The Shieldery]
node.description: Tall columns of polished stone bricks rise high up overhead, each supporting numerous thick and heavy wooden beams that link all of the pillars together. Shields of all shapes and sizes are stacked atop the beams while others hang from either side for viewers below to see. Still more dangle from thick leather straps below the beams and sway gently as the occasional breeze swirls through. From time to time, workers cart out ladders and climb up into the rafters to retrieve a particular shield for one gesturing patron or another.

node.name: [Knight's Hall, Skyward Atrium]
node.description: Fancifully designed sconces brighten the nights with a mix of flickering flames and steady gaethzen globes. A small fountain with crossed stone lightning bolts is perfectly positioned beneath the opened roof to catch any precipitation with funneling assistance from cleverly located, colorful canopies above. The shop entries here are similarly themed with rainbows, glitter-covered raindrops, clouds of cotton and more.

node.name: [Kotu Mart, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass table sits alone on the granite floor, while the silk-covered walls are unadorned. A wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Lasaia's Ferda Sea Fashions, Sales Floor]
node.description: A scuffed sales counter crafted from driftwood sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. Some polished scrimshaw shelves and a knotted flax cargo net hang on the pale brinewood walls with carved wave-covered trim, with a net-wrapped driftwood trunk with rusted hinges along the edges of the room. A cast-off vintner's barrel with burnished copper banding and a steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins sit on the scuffed wooden floor.

node.name: [Lasaia's Ferda Sea Fashions, Sales Floor]
node.description: A scuffed sales counter crafted from driftwood sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. node.name: [Lelliana's Lovely Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the white-veined pink marble floor, with a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the white-veined pink marble walls. Dust has collected in the corners.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Deobar Bower Gate]
node.description: A tremulous throbbing fills the air, replete with murmurings from an unseen host, like pulsations from the heart of the impenetrable forest beyond the barrier of deobars that grow here. Sympathetic vibrations, higher pitched, seem to emanate from the Sana'ati Dyaus at the town's center due northeast. The living wall of trees has been recently fitted with a rattan and wicker gate that remains open night and day, leading out to a road winding south through the forest.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: A break in the living barricade forms a clearing that leads to the southwestern city gate. Through it, all you see is forest beyond, lofty, silent and forbidding. An old ranger, bowed and wizened, hobbles past, spewing a wad of some masticated greenish ooze directly across your path.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: A sudden snap in the deobars overhead is followed by soft, urgent footfalls along the arboreal platforms that circle the Elven stronghold. You can barely hear the creak of a willow bow being drawn taut, ready to loose a well-aimed shaft at the heart of an enemy. Not wishing to stay for target practice, you redouble your pace.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: Fiddlehead ferns and low growing shrubs line both sides of the path between the tree trunks. Many tender young fern stalks poke out of the soil, as though someone had harvested their tips. Along the inner curve are thirsty green willows among whose roots play delicate, crystal trickles of clear water.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: The deobars here sport large patches of brownish-green moss on the north sides of their trunks. The humus on the ground is exceedingly damp as well and home to lichens, toadstools, and clumps of feathery fronds. Your footsteps leave depressions that fill up with small puddles of water.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: Elder Bark Circle intersects with Black Willow Lane to the east here. The junction is broad and the hard packed, rich loam that paves the byways of Leth Deriel looks well trampled. The earth feels solid and comforting beneath your feet, but a damp, musty scent wafts in from the south.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: Peering into the foliage to the southeast, you notice a great black willow tree. Its hoary, drooping branches cascade down and the leaves tumble earthward like innumerable, brilliant green sparks from an Elothean fireworks display. In an upper fork of the willow's massive trunk is a tall, thin structure. With no apparent access from here, there must be some other way to approach the willow.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: The inner arc of the road is bordered by neatly trimmed primrose bushes, a little beyond which are tall stands of poplar, plane and birch in an unlikely mix. Remarkably they are all thriving, magnificent specimens of their kind. Small paths, hardly noticeable at all, leave the main road and meander off into the growth but are too faint to follow.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: A thinning of the wall here lets you catch a glimpse of Oracle Hollow, beyond to the northwest. You feel drawn back to the early ages of Elanthia, to the days of those ancient oracles in primitive times when the forest had a life unto itself. Vows, oaths and prophecies were often uttered in the sheltered glades, canopied groves, the stone cromlechs and sacred precincts of the primeval woods.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle]
node.description: Dense stands of deobars form the town palisades that curve to the northeast and southwest. The impenetrable defense is made even more daunting by clumps of raevelthorn bushes that grow close to the ground in the gaps between the trees. Their branches, with razor sharp thorns facing outward, appear to have been woven craftily among the trees.

node.name: [Leth Deriel, Alder Bower Gate]
node.description: Huge, broad leafed alder trees shoot up tall and straight, sentinels in constant watch over the main gate that leads into and out of Leth Deriel, ancient Elven stronghold. Their spreading crowns meet high overhead, forming a dense, impenetrable roof, as stalwart as any fortress made by nature or artifice. The way leading into the town is quite wide here.

node.name: [Lewkar Awg, The Courtyard]
node.description: A small cobblestone courtyard serves travelers as a place for a short rest, offering a water trough for the animals and benches out of the wind for their riders. In the east and west walls are gates made of stout timbers strapped with brass. A few stone steps lead up to the door of the round tower in the center of the yard.

node.name: [Liriums Or Bust, Sales Floor]
node.description: A heavy glitvire-topped sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the interlocking wooden parquet floor, with a white-veined pink marble pedestal placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and dust has collected in the corners. A massive iroko wardrobe with decorative ironwork and a cherrywood shelf with carved finials line the white-veined pink marble walls. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor.

node.name: [Malk Akom, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood chest and a glass case sit on the stained oak floor, an unconventional approach to displaying goods. Some ironwood shelves hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a glass sideboard along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Malk Akom, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood chest and a glass case sit on the stained oak floor, an unconventional approach to displaying goods. Some ironwood shelves hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a glass sideboard along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Tasting Room]
node.description: Glossy mahogany wainscoting covers the lower halves of the stacked limestone walls. Paintings depicting famous vineyards grace the upper halves, bracketed by the downward curves of the brick ceiling toward the pillars that support it. Comfortable chairs and low tables are arranged companionably near a polished black marble bar containing wines to sample, and a conservatively-dressed male Prydaen stands by to assist.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Bottle Room]
node.description: Racks upon racks of wine bottles line the walls, and between them heavy square columns rise up to join the vaulted ceiling. Each column bears a framed watercolor painting depicting a different wine variety.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Stomping Room]
node.description: Arched brick ceilings converge from four different directions, forming a large double-vaulted room full of compound curves and lined with buttressing columns. An assortment of grape-pressing equipment is lined up along one wall, leaving enough open space that several couples could dance here with room to spare.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Cooper Room]
node.description: Broad square pillars rise up to support the barrel-vaulted brick ceiling, and shop entrances pierce the stacked stone walls in between. This area also contains a working cooperage, and shoppers can pause a while to watch the coopers at hard at work on unfinished barrels with their tools, firepits and racks of supplies close at hand.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Barrel Room]
node.description: Arched openings line the room, formed by the pillars that hold up the low tunnel-vaulted ceiling. Within the openings, the round faces of massive oaken casks protrude, each resting upon a sturdy brick cradle. At the far end, smaller barrels are stacked against the wall, awaiting shipment to wholesale customers.

node.name: [Market Plaza Cellar, Fermentation Room]
node.description: Huge vats line a stacked limestone wall at the cellar's end. An arched brick ceiling looms low overhead, supported by a double row of heavy stone columns that march back toward the center of the cellar on either side. Shop entrances pierce the walls between the columns.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Volcano Room]
node.description: A model of the Greater Fist rests on a display table in the middle of this area, complete with tiny caravans and surrounding towns and villages. The broad white walls between the shops exhibit a collection of fine paintings of volcanoes in varying stages of activity and dormancy.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, River Room]
node.description: An exhibit of framed paintings depicting barges at work and other river scenes decorates the walls between the shops. Windows to the southwest give a panoramic view of the joining of the Segoltha and Oxenwaithe, with the rest of Crossing sprawled around them.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Desert Room]
node.description: Windows look out over western Crossing on one side, and shop entrances are spaced out along the wall opposite them. An exhibit of desert artifacts dominates the center of the room, laid out in a long freestanding glass counter, with a tall potted cactus standing nearby.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Palm Room]
node.description: An atrium of sorts, this room has a high glass ceiling, with tall palm trees in wide planters rising nearly to its peak. A cluster of chairs and small tables underneath allow shoppers to relax and regroup while taking in a grand view of Crossing through the mostly-glass south and east walls.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Ocean Room]
node.description: Reclaimed teak flooring and cypress woodwork, both heavily varnished, give this room a decidedly nautical air. Broad white walls between each pair of shops display a collection of maritime antiques including a ship's bell. The windows on the east wall look out over eastern Crossing, and far beyond that lies the dull blue-gray line of open water.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Tundra Room]
node.description: A massive set of curved mammoth tusks has pride of place in the center of the broad corridor, mounted upon a large glass display. More specimens of tundra life decorate the walls between the shops, allowing visitors to see and learn as they shop.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Jungle Room]
node.description: Stained glass windows with polished teak casements portray various lush jungle scenes, offering filtered light in jewel-like tones. Shop entrances line up opposite, with vases of vibrant jungle flowers mounted on the walls between each set of doors.

node.name: [Market Plaza Upstairs, Savannah Room]
node.description: A framed panoramic painting of a savannah scene occupies the broad white wall between a pair of shop entrances, and glassy-eyed hunting trophies line each wall overhead. Windows on the northern side of the room overlook the Crossing bazaar and the north end of town.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Foyer]
node.description: The high ceiling and sand rose painted walls make this entry feel open and expansive. A large round ironwood table is centered on a thickly-piled rug that covers the middle of the polished marble floor. Large copper urns filled with preserved peacock feathers and fronds have been placed at each corner of a large listings board. Rich brown leather couches line the opposite wall.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Sun Room]
node.description: Painted a soft blue, the walls compliment the matching sunburst stained glass windows that are set in deep frames on each wall. Low wicker benches with moss green cushions are positioned between the entries to the individual shops. Shoppers move along leisurely, arms laden with baskets and bags overflowing with their latest finds.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Meeting Room]
node.description: Carpeting spans the room from wall to wall, muffling the footsteps of the few errant shoppers that have lost their way. A long table with straight-backed chairs pushed tightly against it is the only furniture present. A portrait of a dignified S'kra Mur gentleman hangs at the head.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Dimly-Lit Storage]
node.description: Defying gravity, crates, boxes and stacked tables are piled high along the walls to the ceiling. With a wide cleared path running down the center, light from the entry way quickly diminishes down the length of the room, leaving the far end barely discernable. A push cart holding a large box stands ready for the rest of the inventory to be loaded.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Gladiolus Room]
node.description: Hanging tight to the ceiling, gaethzen lamps in the shapes of large humming birds and butterflies in flight provide a bright light that flows over the enormous round marble planter in the center of the room. Gladiolus in rich soil provides the room with a warm scent and a vivid display of color, ranging from white to shades of deep purple. Elven ivy has been planted around the edge of the flowers and flows over the side to the floor.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Fire Room]
node.description: Passing shoppers stop to take in the vivid mural of the Greater Fist that covers two walls with the artistic rendition of lava flowing into swirls on the shining maple floor. Prickly plants with bright crimson blooms line a burgundy runner laid down the center of the room. Flickering torches in brass sconces are set on either side of the entrances to the trader shops along the walls.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Library]
node.description: Bookcases filled with volumes of varying bindings and size line both lengths of the room, built even above the shop entrances to provide more space. Two rows of benches with padded seats have been placed back to back in the center. An attendant moves about quietly, picking up the stray volumes and at times stopping to climb a small ladder he carries to get a book for anyone interested.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Moon Room]
node.description: A mural of a horizon with a setting sun surrounds the room in variegated shades of rose and purple near the base, moving towards a brushing of silvery grey at the ceiling. On three separate walls, the three moons of Elanthia are in various stages of rising or waning. Constellations have been painted on the floor in splashes of white against the black marble.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Water Room]
node.description: Rounded benches ring a small fountain in the middle of the room. Light from a centralized chandelier reflects off polished glass pieces that have been strewn in the clear crystal water. Small tables with decorated jars holding bamboo shoots are positioned between the entries to each shop.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Lodge Room]
node.description: Windows looking out over a snow-covered mountain terrain have been painted onto the walls. Large game trophies on cherrywood bases are mounted above two lit fieldstone fireplaces on either side of the room. Leather couches draped with snowbeast throws have been placed back to back in the center of the room, a place to rest in comfort before embarking on the next round of shops.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Armor Room]
node.description: Deep-set niches in the walls hold a variety of helms, armets and other head armor. Placed centrally in the room, a tall mannequin fully bedecked in a set of ornamental heavy plate has been polished to a pristine shine. Low chairs have been placed on each side of the shop entrances, the high backs formed from obsidian-bossed tower shields.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Grass Room]
node.description: Intricately woven reeds are displayed in a starburst matting, the differing sized rays pointing to each shop, as if it direct shoppers to their destinations. Baskets are piled artistically along the two long walls of this rectangular room. Guards pass quietly among the shoppers, alert behind their relaxed facade.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Solarium]
node.description: Long panes of glass are set into the long walls near the ceiling. Too high to provide a view of the outside, they allow sunlight for the two rows of topiary animals intermingled with intricately manicured miniature evergreens in large marble urns. Gaps have been left to allow entry into the various shops.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Garden]
node.description: Hedges of varying heights have been grown in amazing patterns throughout the garden. In various corners small white tables, chairs and benches are set to provide a resting spot or a site for intimate conversations. A bronzed statue of a man is in the center, its base ringed with vibrant roses and myrtle.

node.name: [Market Plaza, Forest Room]
node.description: Carved totems have been arranged in a casual snaking pattern down the length of the room. With enough space between them for easy passage to the shop entries, shoppers pause and point out the animals and birds easily recognized in the wood.

node.name: [Martyka's Secret Room, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A large square table crafted from rich red cherrywood and a steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins sit on the dark glazed-tile floor, with a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild and a large teak armoire placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the tapestry-covered pearwood walls.

node.name: [Martyka's Secret Room, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A large square table crafted from rich red cherrywood and a steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins sit on the dark glazed-tile floor, with a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild and a large teak armoire placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the tapestry-covered pearwood walls.

node.name: [Mersaud's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A strong sits odor wafts about. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Mersaud's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A strong sits odor wafts about. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

zone.name: METAL Skin Cloth Bone And TOOLS

node.name: [METAL Skin Cloth Bone And TOOLS, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bearskin-covered sales counter with steel engraving sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken desk and a glass table sit on the oaken floor. Dust has collected in the corners, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force. A ironwood shelf and a glass rack hang on the oak walls. Small puddles of standing water litter the floor, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [METAL Skin Cloth Bone And TOOLS, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bearskin-covered sales counter with steel engraving sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass worktable and a glass table sit on the oaken floor. A wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force, and dust has collected in the corners. A glass rack and a ironwood shelf hang on the oak walls. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and a puddle-shaped stain mars the floor.

node.name: [Mirarva's Mischief And Mayhem, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oak rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a black oak armoir along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits alone on the stained oak floor.

node.name: [Mirarva's Mischief And Mayhem, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oak rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a black oak armoir along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits alone on the stained oak floor. A plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor.

node.name: [Miss Gnomer's, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room. The wooden floor lies empty, leaving customers space to move about freely, and an oak cupboard and an oak armoir line the oaken walls. The shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Mister Purr's Purrfect Paw-nshop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A makeshift sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite shelf and a steel rack hang on the granite walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls, and a plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Dust has collected in the corners, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Mister Purr's Purrfect Paw-nshop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A makeshift sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite shelf and a steel rack hang on the granite walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Dust has collected in the corners, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Muleie's Mercantile, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel cart and an oaken table sit on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Dust has collected in the corners, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room. A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Muleie's Mercantile, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and a steel cart sit on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and dust has collected in the corners. A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room. A swarm of gnats buzzes about the room, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor.

node.name: [My Two Kronars!, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ornate smokewood chest sits on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a silver-veined black marble pedestal and a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Some tiered gloomwood shelves hangs on the silver-veined black marble walls, with a silver-gilt cabinet with frosted glass door panels along the edges of the room.

node.name: [My Two Kronars!, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ornate smokewood chest sits on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a silver-veined black marble pedestal and a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Some tiered gloomwood shelves hangs on the silver-veined black marble walls, with a silver-gilt cabinet with frosted glass door panels along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Mycthengelde, Flatlands]
node.description: Well-worn paths lead through a grove of trees to a gate in The Crossing's western wall. Now and again you hear birds calling to one another in the branches, or the bustling of a merchant's cart as it makes its way past. A handful of adventurers nod at you in greeting as they make their way into town. An aromatic mix of wildflowers mingles with wyndwood, oak and juniper trees as the grove stretches north and south, while to the west, you can see grassy flatlands through a small clearing.

node.name: [Mycthengelde, Flatlands]
node.description: The path winds through a thick grove of trees running north and south along the walls of The Crossing. The pleasant smell of flowers mixed with damp earth permeates the air, and birds sing cheerfully from their homes in the foliage. Directly south, the trees part to reveal a grassy expanse stretching towards a low series of hills.

node.name: [Mycthengelde, Flatlands]
