String cots under the trees provide minimal sleeping accommodations and split tree trunks form the outdoor dining room. Trenches dug along the opposite side of the road offer primitive sanitary facilities.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Endrus Forest]
node.description: Overhead in the foliage, you spot what appear to be gigantic birds' nests in the forks of the trees. Twigs, leafy limbs, dried sedges and grasses, are all piled up into massive arboreal beds. Some primal inhabitants of the deep forest, nomadic hunters and gatherers, must have slept here in the trees for safety. Recalling tales of their poison-tipped arrows, you hope they have long since moved on.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Endrus Forest]
node.description: The road continues to the southwest and northeast, wide enough here to allow pack animals, carts, and small bands of travelers to pass in both directions at once. A view southwest reveals a narrowing of the way, while to the northeast, you see a small clearing and hear strange sounds and cries.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Soothsayer's Hut]
node.description: In the midst of the dense wood, off to the southwest, stands a grey hut supported by the bones of four great birds' feet. Here dwells the mad S'Kra soothsayer, Berdachun. The corners of the hut are carved in the shapes of a lion, a dragon, a cockatrice, and a viper. In front of the hut is a carved oaken basin filled with carcasses of birds and small mammals in various states of decay and disembowelment.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Tripp's Cairn]
node.description: A knot of travelers, pilgrims, traders and adventurers clusters around a pile of stones beneath an old oak on the east side of the path. The trunk of the oak has been riven in twain, perhaps by an ancient lightning strike. The stone cairn is surrounded by offerings of rare herbs, flowers, and clay cups filled with home-brewed ale and sap wine.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Endrus Forest]
node.description: The growth here is deciduous forest, with branches mingling high overhead. A leafy canopy traps the natural moisture given off by the soil and foliage, encouraging mosses, ferns, lichen and fungi to flourish. Deep ruts in the damp roadbed, caused by carts, hooves and boots, show that heavily-laden traffic passes through regularly.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Endrus Forest]
node.description: The grassy, weed-choked flood plain of the Segoltha River to the north transitions into the forest of Endrus. The fringe of the woods here, growing ever denser as you gaze southward, consists mainly of oak and beech, interlaced with whitethorn, tangled briars and low-growing shrubs.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Segoltha Plain]
node.description: The shouts of traders, caravan drivers, soldiers of fortune, scoundrels, thieves, bards, and less unsavory travelers echo across the flood plain along the road here as it narrows. Everyone must jostle each other to pass. Occasionally, a full-blown caravan or war party thunders by, which causes all the foot traffic to leap to the side of the road and turns the shouting to swearing.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Segoltha Plain]
node.description: Sparse grass, weeds and a few hardy shrubs grow along this flat stretch of land that lies between the river bluffs and the nearby woodland. The angry floods sweep away most of the vegetation, and each time the waters subside, life must begin here anew. To the northeast lie the outskirts of Chelsea Overlook, a small community overlooking the south bank of the Segoltha.

node.name: [Southern Trade Route, Endrus Forest]
node.description: The track through the choking forest is difficult to follow here. The path is extremely muddy and treacherous underfoot. At times the snaking detours into which the main route has jumbled become impossible to discern. A spider's web partially blocks the road, waiting to ensnare some unwary traveler.

node.name: [Stalwart Gearworks Inc., Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A lunat rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood armoir along the edges of the room. Dust has collected in the corners, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor.

node.name: [Stalwart Gearworks Inc., Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A lunat rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood armoir along the edges of the room. A wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force, and dust has collected in the corners. An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a plate of food seems to have been spilled on the floor.

node.name: [Starcanth Forge And Mercantile, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A ironwood rack and some steel shelves hang on the oaken walls, with a black oak bar along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls, and muddy tracks smear across the floor. A granite table sits on the granite floor, with a lunat trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and dust has collected in the corners.

node.name: [Starcanth Forge And Mercantile, Sales Floor]
node.description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A ironwood rack and some steel shelves hang on the oaken walls, with a black oak bar along the edges of the room. Grime has collected along the walls, and muddy tracks smear across the floor. A granite table sits on the granite floor, with a lunat trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and dust has collected in the corners.

node.name: [Starkeeper Alley, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and an ironwood workbench sit on the stained oak floor, with a black oak case and a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak armoir stands against the granite walls. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners.

node.name: [Starkeeper Alley, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table and an ironwood workbench sit on the stained oak floor, with a black oak case and a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak armoir stands against the granite walls. Small white cobwebs obscure the corners.

node.name: [Stravaig's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A heavy glitvire-topped sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a heavy ironwood packing crate placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Some polished scrimshaw shelves hangs on the pale brinewood walls with carved wave-covered trim, with a massive iroko wardrobe with decorative ironwork along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Stravaig's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A heavy glitvire-topped sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a heavy ironwood packing crate placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Some polished scrimshaw shelves hangs on the pale brinewood walls with carved wave-covered trim, with a massive iroko wardrobe with decorative ironwork along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Subi's Stuff, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An oaken table sits alone on the granite floor, and a steel rack hangs on the oaken walls. Dust has collected in the corners.

node.name: [Sundries, Sunset, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A deobar shelf hangs on the oaken walls, with a lunat locker along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits alone on the oaken floor.

node.name: [Sundries, Sunset, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A deobar shelf hangs on the oaken walls, with a lunat locker along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits alone on the oaken floor.

node.name: [Sweet Treats, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood worktable and a black oak table sit on the lightly worn pearwood floor. A silver and glass rack with gemstone flowers tucked into the vine-like legs hangs on the soft purple stripe-papered walls. Grime has collected along the walls, and muddy tracks smear across the floor.

node.name: [Sweet Treats, Sales Floor]
node.description: A clouded crystal sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood worktable and a black oak table sit on the lightly worn pearwood floor. A silver and glass rack with gemstone flowers tucked into the vine-like legs hangs on the soft purple stripe-papered walls.

node.name: [Tayria's Trader Tables, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bulky stone sales counter with a gilded crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A triple-tiered display table of translucent polished quartz and a gleaming steel table rising from a central pedestal of carved sana'ati sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with an ornate glass pedestal with carved sana'ati fae legs and a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A silver-gilt cabinet with frosted glass door panels stands against the walls of highly polished Ilithic applewood. A large horsefly buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Tears Of The World Dragon, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A highly polished weapon buffet and a glass table sit on the granite floor, with a granite container shaped like a small mountain placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor. A glass rack hangs on the silk-covered walls. Muddy tracks smear across the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Tears Of The World Dragon, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A highly polished weapon buffet and a glass table sit on the granite floor, with a granite container shaped like a small mountain placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor. A glass rack hangs on the silk-covered walls. Muddy tracks smear across the floor, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Teh Black Market, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood desk and an oaken table sit on the wooden floor, with an oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof. A deobar rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a steel cabinet along the edges of the room. A swarm of gnats buzzes about the room, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Teh Black Market, Sales Floor]
node.description: A messy sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood desk and an oaken table sit on the wooden floor, with an oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof. A deobar rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a steel cabinet along the edges of the room. A swarm of gnats buzzes about the room, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Temple Hill Lane, Salvage Stoneworks]
node.description: With lights dimmed for the night, somber cottages stand across from a large industrial workshop that dominates the south side of the lane. Just visible in the weak light behind the large building is a chute leading down from a quarry that lifts strange vertical shadows into the night sky.

node.name: [Temple Hill, Neighborhood Entrance]
node.description: A pair of stone pillars mark the edge of the neighborhood named Temple Hill. A freshly graded, crushed-stone street carries traffic south into the heart of the community. Running along one side of the lane, a low stone wall, cut with a prominent wrought iron gate, borders the grounds of Temple Hill Manor. Across the street are a row of neat stone cottages.

node.name: [Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]
node.description: The crushed stone of the lane leads between several stone cottages, winding its way deeper into the district. Young locust trees have been planted along both sides of the road in the hopes that with the passage of time they will shade the way.

node.name: [Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]
node.description: Dark iron lanterns hung from tall poles glow softly against the darkness of night. A scattering of pots and vases leave shadows against the somber walls of the homes.

node.name: [Temple Hill, Memorial Park]
node.description: Grass surrounds a small reflecting pool in this wooded park at the top of the hill. Strategically placed low stone benches surround the pool, allowing peaceful contemplation of life. Roses twine along a fence that separates the park from the quarry to the east.

node.name: [Temple of Light, Grand Hall]
node.description: An alabaster dome, inset with crystal prisms and held aloft by vaulted arches, soars above the polished tile floor. Dim light from the stars and city is diffused through the prisms to wash the dome in pale hues. Centered beneath the dome is a fountain bubbling with clear water. A series of detailed mosaic animal images symbolizing the deities paves the path between the fountain and surrounding arches.

node.name: [Temple of Light, Alcove of Eylhaar]
node.description: Dark grey walls enclose a somber chamber dominated by an ebony dais in the center of the room. Censers in the four corners fill the air with the aroma of sandalwood. Worshippers repeat hushed prayers of peace for departed friends and relatives as others sit in silence, remembering the dead. Ebony pews with kneeler boards are set before the altar.

node.name: [Tezler's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A silver-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak stand and a black oak table sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a black oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak rack hangs on the white-veined pink marble walls.

node.name: [Tezler's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A silver-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak stand and a black oak table sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a black oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A black oak rack hangs on the white-veined pink marble walls.

node.name: ['The Cramus Collection', Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A lunat table sits on the granite floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A lunat vanity and a lunat cabinet line the silk-covered walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: ['The Cramus Collection', Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A lunat table sits on the granite floor, with a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A large horsefly buzzes about the room, and a swarm of flies buzzes about the room. A lunat vanity and a lunat cabinet line the silk-covered walls. A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [The Crossing, Sicle Grove Lane]
node.description: A low, shed-like building stands beneath the trees along the road here. It has a gabled roof that dips off to the side, covering a smaller annex from which a vent disgorges noxious vapors into the street. Various antlers, skulls, and tusks decorate the outside of the shed.

node.name: [The Crossing, Truffenyi Place]
node.description: Stands of sicle trees shade the intersection here, and continue to line the lane leading west. Your path follows the town wall, which takes a 90-degree turn here from east to north. Over the wall, to the west, beyond the low fruit trees, you see taller, darker vegetation, as though the forest itself is gathering its forces to lay siege to this outpost of civilization set among the wilderness.

node.name: [The Crossing, Truffenyi Place]
node.description: Truffenyi Place runs straight along the north-south axis of the Crossing and leads to the Guilds and Academy, vital institutions of town life. A quiet but constant buzz of citizens and adventurers engaged in missions, commerce, debate and worship fills the street. More pronounced are the peals of amiable laughter and snippets of modest songs that come from Taelbert's Inn, perched proudly on the west curb.

node.name: [The Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard]
node.description: A side entrance to the Academy, in the form of a low, bronze gate, stands here. Students and faculty come and go through it, since it provides convenient access to the inns and eateries clustered to the north and east of Elanthia's most renowned seat of learning and research. Several blocks to the east looms the dome of the Champions' Arena, which also houses the Barbarians' Guild and farther north, both within and without the sheltering walls of town, lie various other Guilds.

node.name: [The Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard]
node.description: You pause a moment at one of the busiest crossroads of town. Through this intersection must pass most of those traveling from the wilderness of the Western Tier into the heart of the Crossing, and those departing as well. To the east lie the gates to the Eastern Tier, affording access to the Warrior Mages' Guild and the Observatory, and other, more perilous, destinations.

node.name: [The Crossing, S'zella Plaza]
node.description: This small piazza stands between the Academy Asemath and the shops and residences clustered around the Town Green to the east. Its granite pavement has been well-worn, since it forms the north-south connection between the major artery of the Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard, and Lorethew Street. Several stone benches, roughly hewn out of the same material as the pavement, form a semi-circle around a polychrome plaster statue in a quiet corner of the square.

node.name: [The Crossing, Lorethew Street]
node.description: Here figures clad in black flowing robes, trimmed with white piping, wander past in a continuous parade. The focus of the throng is the impressive structure to the northwest, the town's main seat of learning and scholarship, Academy Asemath. It encompasses libraries, dormitories, convocations and lectures by the most respected thinkers of Elanthia. Some of the facilities are open to the public, while others are restricted to faculty, students and alumni.

node.name: [The Crossing, Asemath Walk]
node.description: You stand before a sign in the shape of a giant lute, painted in red and gilt and inlaid with ivory and jet, with florid script proclaiming the virtues of the True Bard d'Or, the Crossing's finest purveyor of high-quality instruments for bards, aesthetes and amateurs alike. Dashing, gaily-clad figures stream in and out of the shop, lutes slung over shoulders or pipes clasped under arms. A haunting tune, at once both exhilarating and melancholic, emanates from the doorway.

node.name: [The Crossing, Asemath Walk]
node.description: Small groups of students walk by talking in animated fashion, some excitedly about the night's feature show at the famed taproom of the Half Pint Inn, others laughing themselves wearily home after a too many few rounds of liquid libation. The well-lit inn to the south as well as the blazing flames on the towers of the High Temple to the southeast add to the cheery street atmosphere.

node.name: [The Crossing, Asemath Walk]
node.description: Normally filled with bustling Clerics, academics and carousers of all types and ages, this area is peaceful as most people have retired for the night, excepting the occasional joyous song that escapes an open window from the back of the two-storied Half Pint Inn to the south. The side of the Cleric's shop is to the east, bordering the smooth paving stones that have been laid to coordinate with the approaches of the High Temple.

node.name: [The Crossing, Alamhif Trace]
node.description: This normally sedate area is nearly still in the night hours, the occasional late-night shopper heading to or from Brother Durantine's Cleric Shop, which hugs the north side of the road. A hooded monk exits the shop into the shadows and fingers his prayer beads with unconscious familiarity as he glances up at the bright flame on the High Temple tower to the southwest, pausing a moment before continuing his journey.

node.name: [The Crossing, Alamhif Trace]
node.description: This pivotal junction connects many of the Crossing's key locations. Blazing to the south in the night sky are the flames on the Temple's three towers, while the lights of Town Green and Town Hall can be seen off towards the north and northeast. The babble of many languages, clan and guild and folk fill the air here, busy at every hour. Travelers dressed in all manner of costume, garb and battle gear amble past, admiring the darkened outlines of the buildings, or looking about to get their bearings.

node.name: [The Crossing, Hodierna Way]
node.description: The hustle of crowds making their way between the secular and religious centers of town that converge here carries you along with its momentum. The granite and marble facade of the First Provincial Bank catches your eye, standing before you as solid as its name. A Gor'Tog guard armed with pike and crossbow is posted at the door, while a few well-dressed merchants congregate outside.

node.name: [The Crossing, Lunat Shade Road]
node.description: Majestic lunat trees line this byway, donated by the town's prosperous traders, a reminder of how their Guild delights in improving the quality of life for beings all over Elanthia. One such wealthy merchant, though not as ostentatious as most, is Berolt, the dry goods dealer. His venerable general store here outfits adventurers with all the basic necessities. The row of trees on the north side of the street also serves to shade the south half of Town Green.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green South]
node.description: A gap in the stand of lunat trees leads south into Lunat Shade Road. In that general direction the lights shining from Berolt's Dry Goods, the Town Hall, the soaring presence of the Temple, the Provincial Bank and other key structures can be seen. A few loafers loll on the grass, watching those entering and leaving the green, or laying back to gaze at the night sky. A lone nightingale serenades from the hedges bordering the park, unaware of its appreciative audience.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green Southeast]
node.description: This tranquil corner of the Green has a small bower of entwined modwyn vines, laden with tempting, grape-like clusters. A limestone bench and some sawed-off sections of trees that serve as rustic stools make up an open-air performance space, where bards, musicians and poets can demonstrate their talents.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green Northeast]
node.description: The cool, welcome expanse of the Town Green is a pleasant place to gather and exchange news, gossip and adventuring pointers with all the folk and races of Elanthia who are drawn to town. A soft, spongy carpet of well-manicured grass underfoot affords a comfortable cushion for sitting or sprawling beneath the star-studded night sky. An ancient oak tree provides shelter for those so inclined.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green North]
node.description: A small path of bent grass leads to a narrow stretch of cobblestones between the grass and the privet hedge that stands before Milgrym the Weaponsmith's. The town's main source of serviceable arms, Milgrym does a good trade and has a solid reputation. The stream of customers, though steady, seems careful not to disturb the usual tranquility of the facing greensward.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green Northwest]
node.description: The entrance to Tembeg's Armory is through a hacked-out breach in the thick hedges that border the Green here. Tembeg, being a humble sort, has laid down a few planks leading into his establishment to serve as a walkway. Samples of his work are hung on hooks on the exterior of the unpainted wood structure but no sign or other eye-catching gimmicks are noticeable.

node.name: [The Crossing, Town Green Southwest]
node.description: The hedgerow to the west meets the row of tall lunat trees that separates the Town Green from the commercial traffic on Lunat Shade Road due south. The growth is especially dense here, with no way to slip past either of the living fences. The small thorns on the hedges, to keep out stray livestock in search of prime pasture, look daunting in any case.

node.name: [The Crossing, Via Iltesh]
node.description: The lane is quite narrow here, with the sides of the Armorer's and Weaponsmith's shops encroaching on the path itself. Their huddling structures and the shady hedges and lunats that form this northern boundary of the Town Green cause slippery moss to grow upon the cobblestones and cast a cool, damp pall over this end of the street.

node.name: [The Crossing, Via Iltesh]
node.description: This small lane off of Clanthew Boulevard narrows to the south and grows wider as it leads north into the main road, giving it a shape reminiscent of the blade of a huge greatsword. Due south you can see the verdant border of the Town Green and the shops of the Weaponsmith and Armorer. To the northeast is the dome of the Champions' Arena and to the west, the three-story colonnades of the Academy dominate the skyline.

node.name: [The Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard]
node.description: The cobblestones here are grey and flecked with crystals that sparkle as you move along the boulevard. High walls over which loom still higher structures with shuttered, mute windows that face the street and baked tile roofs, indicate you are passing through one of the wealthier residential sections of the Crossing.

node.name: [The Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard]
node.description: From the west comes the sound of currents rushing through a narrow river bend, while in the distance, just barely evident to the northwest, is a corner of the outer town wall, over which the calls of birds can be heard. Mingled among the sublime sounds of nature, are the equally sweet sounds reaching your ears from a small, unpretentious building set unobtrusively off to the south side of the road.

node.name: [The Crossing, Clanthew Boulevard]
node.description: The meandering course of the River Oxenwaithe lies dead ahead. Wooden carts, powered by all manner of two- and four-legged beasts, rumble past, headed west towards the broad, well-worn planks of the Oxenwaithe Bridge and east into the heart of the Crossing. Groups of armed adventurers, mystics, merchants and rogues weave in and out of the wheeled and hoofed mobs.

node.name: [The Crossing, Oxenwaithe Bridge]
node.description: This bridge is wide and sturdy, its strong oaken planks weathered but in good repair. Across this span must stream all the traffic directly proceeding to or coming from the Northern and Western Tiers. Oxcarts laden with imports and exports rumble past.

node.name: [The Crossing, Goodwhate Pike]
node.description: The gates to the west, the river and Oxenwaithe Bridge to the east, the town walls and dense forests and scrub just beyond to the north - all serve as a reminder of the dichotomy between the untamed forces of nature and the works of mortals that life in Elanthia constantly confronts its inhabitants with. Such cosmic musings are soon cut short, however, as a foul-smelling Dwarf barbarian shoves aside a few passersby rudely and lumbers past.

node.name: [The Crossing, Goodwhate Pike]
node.description: A long, barn-like structure hunkers just by the road here, wedged between the cobbled way and the high outer walls of town that lie just north. A very high, very wide double door leads in and from it the lowing of oxen, the whinnying of steeds and the braying of obstinate pack animals can be heard. An exotic-looking trader in a silk robe forcibly leads a recalcitrant camel from the building, almost knocking a nearby attendant to the ground.

node.name: [The Crossing, Goodwhate Pike]
node.description: Old woodframe buildings that appear to be vacant border the wide pike here. Heavy traffic has taken its toll, leaving deep ruts and almost demolishing the curb, so that the already decrepit mud-and-twig structures almost seem to spill out upon the road. You have no doubt that, during the height of the rainy season, they literally do. Directly west lies the Western Gate.

node.name: [The Crossing, Western Gate]
node.description: Camels, oxen, and mules compete with Elves, Gor'Togs, and Humans to pass through the narrow gate which breaches the stone wall between town and the western reaches. The lowing of animals, and the bellowing of irate travelers become almost indistinguishable the more you listen. After a few minutes, so do the unmistakable odors of unwashed sojourners and domestic beasts of burden. It begins to dawn on you why folks are anxious to pass through customs, whatever the cost, as quickly as possible.

node.name: [The Crossing, Sirenberry Row]
node.description: The daunting, austere structure of Academy Asemath, directly east, blocks out the light, and leaves the humble facade on the other side of the path in intermittent shade. Scholars and singers, teachers and troubadours, mimes and masters all saunter past, content in their mutual feelings of superiority. Round the corner, you can just spy a gaudy sign on a shop to the east.

node.name: [The Crossing, Lorethew Street]
node.description: The path here follows the curves of the Oxenwaithe, bringing you nearer to the swirling, dark currents. Along the bank, to the southwest, you make out several dinghies bobbing and straining at their moorings, in a doomed dance of freedom they can never win, except at the behest of some greedy ferryman or in the wake of a storm.

node.name: [The Crossing, Lorethew Street]
node.description: This narrow road runs east-west between the Academy and many of the town's shops. To the east you can see the low shops and hedges that surround the Town Green, while west looms the tributary river, flowing on its winding course south into the mighty Segoltha River.

node.name: [The Crossing, Hodierna Way]
node.description: When no straggling pedestrian heads home for the night and no squeaking caravan wheels break the silence, sometimes a nightingale can be heard. Lamps in the windows of the Orders headquarters show someone is working late, and light shines to the southwest, where the Temple illuminates the dark sky.

node.name: [The Crossing, Albreda Boulevard]
node.description: The blank side of the Town Hall building stands to the west, its modest construction evident from this oblique angle. Upscale emporiums and services line the east side of the broad boulevard here, with shoppers casually glancing in the windows and doors to see the latest in trade goods from the outlying lands of Elanthia.

node.name: [The Crossing, Albreda Boulevard]
node.description: This broad junction links Albreda Boulevard with the pleasant, tree-lined street to the west and the flower-dappled lane to the north. Such a refreshing vista invites you to stop and soak in the town's atmosphere. To the west you see the gabled slate roof of Town Hall. From the northwest comes the hue and cry of itinerant merchants, peddlers and soothsayers, vying for the attention of the adventurers gathered there in the Town's Green.

node.name: [The Crossing, Betany Street]
node.description: Adventurers stroll through the night air, some retiring to their guilds while others still intent on training stride purposefully in those directions. The normally bustling area is peaceful, the twittering of a few nightingales interspersing with the quiet conversations of people just passing through. Albreda Boulevard flows into Betany Street here, while a low hedgerow due west divides this corner from Town Green. An iron Temple walkway hovers over the outline of Town Hall to the southwest.

node.name: [The Crossing, Betany Street]
node.description: Potted plants and verdant window boxes decorate the front of Marcipur's Stitchery here. Climbing vines of maiden tress plants poke their tendrils into any nook or cranny afforded by the clean, white stucco walls, including windows and the door. Rather plainly dressed women file into the Stitchery, while stunningly garbed ones, attired in the latest adventuring fashions, emerge, all smiles.

node.name: [The Crossing, Betany Street]
node.description: Someone has taken the time and care to attach flowerpots to the stone wall here, and plant cheerful flowers and fragrant herbs in them. It provides a lovely contrast to the fact that it was built to keep out marauders bringing death and destruction. The wall curves gently northeast, and off in the distance to the west, on either side of the street, you see the Seamstress and the Jeweler's shop, both about a block away.

node.name: [The Crossing, Oralana Ramble]
node.description: You are traveling just inside the eastern town wall. Mosses, grasses, and weeds blooming with brilliant wildflowers grow between the road and the wall, climbing right up to the edge of the rampart itself. The way bends to the southwest, and continues straight north toward the northeastern gate.

node.name: [The Crossing, Oralana Ramble]
node.description: The road continues north and south, and merges on the west with Trothfang Street. In that direction, you see the turquoise- and crimson-tiled dome of the Champions' Arena. Your proximity to the town wall blocks out any view of the Eastern Tier which lies beyond it. Lowering your gaze to the path beneath your feet, you notice a spotted beetle wriggle into a chink in the wall and disappear.

node.name: [The Crossing, Oralana Ramble]
node.description: A great deal of traffic passes through here, as travelers, merchants, rogues, adventurers, ne'er-do-wells and savants make their way to and from the Eastern Tier. The Ramble continues south, leading into the heart of the Crossing, while a stone's throw away are the northeast gates. All these pedestrians make this the ideal location for the shop of Talmai the Cobbler, whose business in new footwear and repairs prospers despite his lack of shrewdness.

node.name: [The Crossing, Oralana Ramble]
node.description: Oralana Ramble runs along the east wall of town, leading between the Northeast and the Eastern Gates. Somehow, it is relatively calm and empty compared to those roads that lead west and southwest to the Town Green, Town Hall, the Bank and the other vital nerve centers of the Crossing. The three towers guarding the temple thrust into the sky to the southwest, their flames a beacon for miles. The shadowy images of nightingales swoop high in the sky, their gentle lullabies decorating the cool night air.

node.name: [The Crossing, Firulf Vista]
node.description: Utter bedlam confronts you as you step out into this street. This is the point where anyone and everyone who passes through the Northeast Gate either leaving town or arriving must cross paths. You quickly conclude this is no spot to stop and admire the scenery of the regions of the Eastern Tier beyond, nor to study the local architecture around you, since the momentum of the crowd carries you along, almost without your realizing it.

node.name: [The Crossing, Northeast Customs]
node.description: Here stands the Northeast Gate, two massive doors of steel-banded ironwood securely attached to the masonry of the town walls. The traffic here is thick with travelers, and the Customs Officers are alert to any sign of trouble.

node.name: [The Crossing, Eastern Gate]
node.description: Camels, oxen and mules compete with Elves, Gor'Togs and Humans to pass through the Eastern Gate which leads to the Middens, and the Observatory beyond. The lowing of animals and the bellowing of travelers become almost indistinguishable the more you listen. After a few minutes, so do the mingled odors of unwashed sojourners and beasts of burden. It begins to dawn on you why folks are anxious to pass through customs, whatever the cost, as quickly as possible.

node.name: [The Crossing, Hodierna Way]
node.description: The wall surrounding the town snakes from north to south directly to the east. The towers of the Temple to the west are barely seen in the dark, its merry lights minutely visible in the distance, twinkling through stained-glass windows. To the north, a narrow, cheerful street opens up.

node.name: [The Crossing, Hodierna Way]
node.description: Much of the heavy traffic that passes along Hodierna Way bespeaks of its place as a vital link through town to the shops, public institutions and the guilds, as well as to the observatory and rocky coast eastward beyond the wall. Part of the rush here, no doubt, is generated by Catrox's Forge, where the repair and refurbishing of arms, armor and shields draws a constant clientele of ardent adventurers.

node.name: [The Crossing, Manciple Cobble]
node.description: This cobbled street connects the Town Green with the streets leading to Academy Asemath and the shops, inns and eateries that cluster around it. Old stone residences line the walkway, making it more like a court than a through street. Your footsteps echo off their unyielding, secretive facades.

node.name: [The Crossing, Puddle Path]
node.description: The packed dirt path between bustling Town Green and the quieter confines of Smithy Lane has been worn to a smooth, deep hollow over the years. A perennial pool of murky brown water now sits obstinately in the center of the path, requiring passers-by to gather up their hems or risk a muddying. From time to time, small boys have been known to hide in the bushes bordering the path, hoping for a tantalizing glimpse of a lady's ankle.

node.name: [The Crossing, Smithy Lane]
node.description: Clean, golden straw strews the walkway inside a low wooden gate, cushioning the dirt path underfoot and providing a ready source of nesting materials for the occasional bold sparrow. A cluster of immaculate thatched cottages enjoys this vantage point, their brightly-curtained windows affording a pleasant view of the residents and visitors passing back and forth on their daily business.

node.name: [The Crossing, Smithy Lane]
node.description: This stretch of the lane is nothing more than a packed earth track bordered by grassy verges, but even so it is neatly criss-crossed with the even strokes of a willow broom. Several of the homes here boast intricate knotted adornments of dried wildflowers and pungent herbs hanging under their eaves. Punctuating the lush green verges, flat white stepping-stones lead to the front door of each tidy cottage.

node.name: [The Crossing, Smithy Lane]
node.description: A raised pavement of speckled granite cobbles runs along the center of the lane. Stucco-fronted cottages stand in smart rows on either side, their squat chimneys exhaling hazy clouds of bluish charcoal smoke. The inviting aroma of hearty stew and fresh-baked bread permeates the air, combining comfortably with the warm scent of drying pine that emanates from a large woodpile between two homes.

node.name: [The Crossing, Crofton Walk]
node.description: Sparkling white-painted wooden benches sit beneath ivied trellises at intervals around this tidy square, each tranquil bower carefully placed to provide a pleasant view of a crescent-shaped ornamental pond. Flowerbeds fashioned from interlocking blocks of smooth granite and sandstone dot the square, their bright displays ablaze with seasonal blossoms and neatly-trimmed shrubs.

node.name: [The Crossing, Crofton Walk]
node.description: An ancient oak tree dominates this corner of the lane, its massive trunk and outstretched boughs dwarfing the neat cottages under its broad span. Noticeable fractures in the cobblestone pavement stretching some twenty paces from the oak's base bear witness to the extent of its root mass, but the homes clustered upon the uneven ground seem to glory in its grandeur all the same.

node.name: [The Crossing, Crofton Walk]
node.description: A mosaic of red, umber and brown baked clay tiles spreads across the footpath here, the tiles' earthy tones swirling in a pattern reminiscent of windblown autumn leaves. Several enormous oaks stand aside the unusual pavement, their enormous boughs bending over rows of tidy stone cottages and carefully-planted gardens of herbs and roses.

node.name: [The Edge of the Forest, Before the Dragon's Breath]
node.description: The lushness of the forest begins to form a living wall, the leaves of the towering trees tinted with the dark hue of brightly-polished scales. The path to the north dwindles into the more sinister area of the harsh mountains.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: Dirt meets stone here as a road begins its winding journey north along a cut-out hillside shrouded by a grove of trees. Just a few hundred feet north a large growth of reeds forces a jog to the northwest. In a clump of weeds sits a makeshift stone bench and small pile of stones. If it was once a shrine, someone has long since removed the statue and abandoned its care.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: The stones of the road fit seamlessly together, locked to each other without mortar. Traces of rust form two paths in this curve where the iron rims of the wagon wheels have paid the price of taking the turn too fast. A bullfrog croaks out his presence somewhere in the tall reeds that line the road. The shade of the trees to the northwest is alluring yet daunting.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: Gnats swarm annoyingly about your head, prompting you to bat at them with your hand in vain. To the north, you can see where the road leaves the shadows and enters the safety of daylight about a half a mile away. Curving to the southeast, the road leads you to the closest exit for this grove. Moss clings to the stones of the road where it meets the water and reeds to the east.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: Some reeds have been hacked away close to the road, undoubtedly destined to become someone's new basket. The removal has left an opening in the reeds allowing you to peer into the marsh on the other side which seemingly waits for its next victim. A water beetle that is traveling through the mud stops and waves its feelers at you in what seems to be a challenge before continuing on its way.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: The lack of direct sunlight here is daunting. You can't seem to suppress the notion this is the perfect place for highway bandits to ply their trade. Squinting at the deeper shadows, you search the area for possible ambush locations and poke at the reeds just to make sure. A quick glance north and south confirms you are in the middle of the grove.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: High reeds create a thick wall to the southeast. A makeshift target is tacked to the closest tree. Someone has been practicing their archery, and on closer inspection you see the arrowheads that are now and forever a part of the tree. To the northwest you see a large bridge now in ruin, which used to span the river. To the south the road heads directly into the shadows of a grove of trees.

node.name: [The Marsh, Stone Road]
node.description: A large stone bridge that once spanned the river here now lies in ruins. The town of Riverhaven, the bridge's original destination, sits on the other side. Gazing at the town, you notice that a brown haze lingers in the air, no doubt the result of the forges and smokehouses at work. To the southeast, a wall of reeds creeps down from a group of trees into the river and attempts to survive its currents.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: Just inside the great gates of the entrance is a statue of Hodierna, dividing the traffic that streams to her right or left and towering over the travelers who pass by. A riot of carved figures covers the walls and arches high over the statue's head. The stone seems almost supple, flowing into interlaced columns, branches of trees, and limbs of animals in a design that teases the eye and awes the imagination.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: A statue of a Dwarf three times life-size stands against the north wall between two glowing oil lamps. In the distance to the west, the light from the entrance silhouettes a figure reaching from the floor almost to the high ceiling; to the east, lines of bright lamps recede into the darkness of the tunnel.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: A statue against the north wall watches over a highway that looks broad enough for three mammoths to walk abreast with the tops of their howdahs never touching the ceiling. Oil lamps hang from bronze brackets set high on the fluted half-columns spaced evenly along the polished stone walls.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: A row of stone benches offers comfort to travelers who want to pause in their journey. Instead of facing the highway, however, the benches are turned in a half-circle toward the towering stone figure against the north wall, as if waiting for an audience. Nearby, a fountain on the wall splashes into a bronze basin.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: Lamps brightly illuminate the tunnels' polished surfaces and the statue against the south wall. Yet something seems odd about the light in the vicinity, as if the lamps here were not quite aligned with those to the east and west, and the floor feels slippery underfoot.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: The underground highway bends in a wide curve past a huge statue against the outer wall. Twin rows of lights extend to the west, receding to a vanishing point beyond the range of sight. To the north, the way is lit by the light of day.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: High on the outer wall, just where it begins to arch toward the center of the ceiling, is a row of shafts bored through the stone. Beams of light stream through these openings, dappling the highway with pools of brightness in the shapes of arcane symbols -- moons in all their phases, constellations of stars, the planets. None of the light quite reaches the statue against the inner wall.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: The variety and size of the wall carvings along the highway speak of countless hours of patient labor by master craftsmen and designers. In this stretch of the tunnel, openings form the silhouette of a vast city skyline in the outer wall, showing towers, walls, temples, and bridges in fine detail. Against the west wall stands a huge statue.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: The outer wall bears a panoramic carving in relief: it shows a wide door set into the face of a mountain with troll-like figures on either side of the door. The guards (if that is what they are) have their hands raised, palms outward, as if forbidding entrance. The ominous sculpture contrasts sharply with the rather domestic statue on the western wall.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: The petals, leaves, stem, and even thorns of an immense rose are carved into the top half of the outer wall. Concentric circles of openings pierce the rock, outlining and forming the face of the flower. Light from the embrasures falls on a statue against the western wall.

node.name: [The Road Beneath the Mountain]
node.description: Just inside the great gates of the entrance stands a statue of Kertigen, stretching from floor to ceiling and diverting travelers to one side or the other. He faces the entrance to the north. To his right, the eastern wall of the tunnel is pierced with a multitude of openings, carvings of such intricacy that the wall resembles a curtain embroidered in stone.

node.name: [The Western Road, Foothills]
node.description: Northward lies a heavily forested region cast in shade so deep it's hard to see more than a score of yards in that direction. To the south the forest is not so dense, although the trees and the ridges still limit the line of sight.

node.name: [The Western Road, Foothills]
node.description: The road dips slightly between the path north through the forest and a steeper rise to the southeast. Off to one side, victim of some misfortune, sits an abandoned wagon -- or what's left of it after passersby have stripped it of usable parts.

node.name: [The Western Road, Atop the Ridge]
node.description: The top of the ridge has been cleared of trees where the road crosses, revealing a sweeping vista of jagged, snow-capped mountains to the west and north, the Himineldar Shel and its Dark Pass. To the southwest, a lone hill rises above the plain.

node.name: [The Western Road, Stream Bank]
node.description: A steeply inclined road joins the top of a ridge to the west to the stream that runs through the valley. The ridge is thickly forested with long-leaf pines, hemlocks and some mountain laurel, but the woods seem thinner toward the top.

node.name: [The Western Road, The Stream]
node.description: The mud of a lower bank to the west is marked with footprints and wagon tracks, evidence of a pretty steady flow of traffic. Probably many of those feet, sore from their wayfaring, have found refreshment in these waters.

node.name: [The Western Road, The Stream]
node.description: The comfortable current and the pebbly bottom of the shallow stream make about as good a road as any on this long trek. The bank is high and undercut to the west, and the water deepens to the south, making both of those directions look chancy.

node.name: [The Western Road, Stream Bank]
node.description: A shallow stream running down the valley crosses the road, its banks decorated by leafy ferns. Frogs call, birds sing and dragonflies dart and hover over the water. To the southeast, the road runs uphill through a big meadow.

node.name: [The Western Road, Big Meadow]
node.description: Scrub brush and low saplings flank the road at the lower, western end of a big clearing, not far from a stream in the valley. Higher up, the meadow looks freer of the encroaching forest.

node.name: [The Western Road, Big Meadow]
node.description: The road crosses the eastern end of a big clearing, an unusual sight in the wooded foothills. No mark of axe or saw can be seen, so the lea must have resulted from a natural event, perhaps a forest fire. Downhill to the west, saplings around the edge show the slow return of the trees, and in fifty years no trace will remain of the meadow.

node.name: [The Western Road, The Spring]
node.description: A mountain spring has been cleaned out near the road and piped into a stone trough, making the cold water available for man and beast alike. The overflow from the trough runs downhill into the forest, away from the road, which follows higher ground.

node.name: [The Western Road, Atop the Ridge]
node.description: The tread of many, many patient boots and hooves has worn the roadway down, and it crosses the top of the ridge several feet below the shoulders on either side. The sunken path and the surrounding forest dim the light guiding the traveler's way, even on the brightest day.

node.name: [The Western Road, Foothills]
node.description: Although the road is not terribly steep, a dislodged stone or a kicked pine cone may well roll a good distance before coming to rest. One might enjoy a good view of the countryside from here, midway up the side of the ridge, were it not for the thick stand of pines that lines the road.

node.name: [The Western Road, Foothills]
node.description: Obstinate ridges run north and south, frustrating travelers whose journeys go from east to west and back again. One such ridge to the west forces the road through several switchbacks along a forested hillside.

node.name: [The Western Road, Foothills]
node.description: The road occasionally greets a tilled field, but for the most part, scrub grasses separate stands of trees. The groups of sumac, laurel, birch, and a few firs are denser and more numerous to the west than to the east.

node.name: [The Western Road, Farmlands]
node.description: A boldly carved wooden figure stands on a polished sandstone slab in the middle of the road, surrounded by piles of drying flowers, food, and other offerings. A circle of benches surrounds the statue for those who wish to break their journey for rest or reflection.

node.name: [The Western Road, Farmlands]
node.description: On each side of the road is a colonnade of yew trees whose lines extend a fair distance to the east and whose fallen needles hush the noises of the road. Whoever planted the big trees wanted something impressive, even showy, and they serve the purpose well.

node.name: [The Western Road, A Ruined Manse]
node.description: A short avenue of yew trees leads to a low pile of rubble. It must have been a noteworthy manse at one time: the extent of the remains, the carriage drive before what was its entrance, and the circle of sheltering trees all bespeak a residence of importance in the region.

node.name: [The Western Road, Farmlands]
node.description: Yew trees line the road, bordering it in a stately procession to the west. A carpet of their fallen needles cushions the wheel or foot that travels in their shade. Judging from their size, the trees have a few years on them and were obviously placed by design rather than nature.

node.name: [The Western Road, Farmlands]
node.description: Fields to the north and south of the road look cultivated, or at least were tilled some short time in the past. The road is in good repair, which argues for a local population that takes on the task of maintenance.

node.name: [The Western Road, Vista]
node.description: Rolling plains stretch to a range of faraway mountains on the western horizon. The road, however, links the bluff and the rising ground to the northwest, a region of low ridges and small groves of trees.

node.name: [Tiddeggur's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A simple steel sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood table and an oaken stand sit on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor. A steel shelf hangs on the oaken walls. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [Tiddeggur's Shop, Sales Floor]
node.description: A simple steel sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood table and an oaken stand sit on the bare floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and the shattered remnants of a glass object are spread across the floor. A steel shelf hangs on the oaken walls. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and grime has collected along the walls.

node.name: [Tipsy Taboo, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the oaken floor, with a white ironwood armor stand with muracite handles placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Tipsy Taboo, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide lunat sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel trestle table inlaid with half-melted bronze coins and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the oaken floor, with a white ironwood armor stand with muracite handles placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet along the edges of the room.

node.name: [Tremagis's Furs, Showroom]
node.description: The acrid scent of curing vats and tallow reeks in the air here, a heavenly perfume to people like Tremagis, who runs the commercial furmongering in Shard from his workshop in the next room over. Trophies of his handiwork in the form of stretched, soft doeskin and stiff worked fur shells hang on the walls, all but covering them.

node.name: [Tremagis's Furs, Furmongering]
node.description: Stacks of cured hides and the stench of uncured ones fills this small back room. Tremagis, the furrier who runs this establishment, growls and grumbles as the local trappers and hunters arrive with their furs to exchange for coins.

node.name: [Trindin's Lost And Found, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood rack and a knotted flax cargo net hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a glass cabinet along the edges of the room. An ironwood bin and a heavy ironwood packing crate sit on the lightly worn pearwood floor, an unconventional approach to displaying goods.

node.name: [Trindin's Lost And Found, Sales Floor]
node.description: A sturdy pearwood sales counter branded with the crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood rack and a knotted flax cargo net hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a glass cabinet along the edges of the room. An ironwood bin and a heavy ironwood packing crate sit on the lightly worn pearwood floor, an unconventional approach to displaying goods.

node.name: [Tsuchikage's Place, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bulky stone sales counter with a gilded crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A polished walnut table with four carved legs and a velvet-covered display sit on the gold-veined black marble floor, with a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the gold-veined black marble walls. A wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force, and small piles of garbage litter the floor.

node.name: [Tsuchikage's Place, Sales Floor]
node.description: A bulky stone sales counter with a gilded crest of the Traders' Guild sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A velvet-covered display and a polished walnut table with four carved legs sit on the gold-veined black marble floor, with a squat pearwood pedestal gilded with the crest of the Traders' Guild placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. Dust has collected in the corners. A cherrywood shelf with carved finials stands against the gold-veined black marble walls. Small piles of garbage litter the floor, and a wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force.

node.name: [Undergondola, Narrow Path]
node.description: Widening and flattening out, the steep climb begins to level into a narrow path up the mountainside. Tall purple lupine blossoms line the trail, their fragrance mingling with the crisp mountain air in a refreshing pause on an arduous journey.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: The surroundings grow dimmer, the flora itself seeming more monotone than at the entrance to this bizarre garden. Moving into the heart of the wood, everything seems to shift from vibrant, explosive colors into chalky, dull greys.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Tufts of dry, scraggly witchgrass nestle at the base of a nearby tree to garner shelter and shade. This particular tree looks rather sickly, as if stricken with something that its neighbors have not yet caught.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Desiccated amethyst vines hang limp off the side of a nearby tree, their delicate forms crushed and dominated by the thicker green vines armed with thorny red barbs. The cycle of life in this habitat becomes clearer, and it is certain that all is not as it may appear.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: The sound of water dripping in the distance echoes quietly, steadily keeping the pulse of the forest. The rhythm is fragile yet determined, as if the slightest tilt could shatter its equilibrium and end the balance of life in this oddly beautiful place.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A single tree lies rotting and shattered amidst a colony of its healthier brethren. The omnipresent thorny red-tinted vines are curiously absent around it, although what is left of its bark has been scarred horribly with gouge marks.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A velvety carpet of flora explodes suddenly into being in this spot, bearing vibrant flowers and plants of all colors and shapes. A sense of exuberance permeates the air here, as if it were charged with the essence of Life itself.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Silvery dew trickles off of the dark green vines dangling from the verdant patchwork sky, forming small pools of glassy crystal that echo their muted cries of disruption at each intermittent drop.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A curtain of undulating maiden's tresses is visible high in the treetops above, twitching about in search of warm flesh to devour in its deadly embrace. All is quiet save for the rustling of the tress vines, as if the forest denizens avoid this area and the bizarre plant's seductive, predatory dance. For now, it remains at its perch, granting passage to those who are swift.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A pool of gleaming silvery water yawns open in the earth, its surface glassy and serene. Blooming amethyst vines emerge from its depths to coil up the side of a nearby yew tree. The darker crimson-tinted vines seem to shy away from the pool, rejecting the nourishment it supplies.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A massive black willow looms the height of twenty Gor'Togs or more, casting a pall of shade over the silent forest floor. The sheer number and variety of shrubs, trees, and vines basking beneath it is startling, as if this lush forest was host to every variety of plant known to mortals -- and surely some that have yet to be discovered.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Giant ferns sweep out into the pathway here, brushing passersby with their feathery fronds. The distant sounds of trickling water cascades through the air, beckoning from the depths of the mysterious wood.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A single tree lies toppled in the pathway, covered with a carpet of red-thorned dark green vines. With sporadic movements, the vines twitch and twist over the withering ironwood husk, as if sapping it of its very life.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: The pungent aroma of jasmine perfumes the air, although no blossoms are visible. Silvery strands of a tangled widow's web stretch between the branches of a stunted witchclaw tree, adorning it like a fine-jeweled platinum glove.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A teetering wild plum tree flanks the path, burdened by a shawl of the omnipresent green vines tinged with red highlights. The thorns of each vine dig and pierce into the wounded tree's fleshy bark, as if feasting upon fallen prey.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Tangled masses of dark green vines dangle down from their perches, interwoven into the treetop canopy far above the forest floor. The rustling of leaves is audible in the distance, yet the presence of wildlife seems strangely absent.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Soft patches of black lichen show up sparsely on the soil, intertwined with widow's lace and dark green moss. Trees of all shapes, sizes and colors writhe up from the soil in all directions. Woven amidst the branches of every tree are dark green vines tinged with a crimson gleam, a curious sign of foreboding to the experienced tracker.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A severely knotted witchclaw tree rises in the center of the path, its barren branches entangled in pale silver amethyst vines blooming with vibrant violet blossoms. The scene is a stark contrast of despair and beauty, one that is prevalent in this mysterious forest.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: Thin veils of black widow's lace grass drape over the soft soil, silencing every step as if it were enfolded in its own void. The foliage seems to stir constantly when glimpsed peripherally, yet no movement can be discerned in the immediate surroundings.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: The audible trickling of water beckons seductively from its unseen source. A twisted myriad of dark vines stretch from the treetops above, blocking out all light -- whether by sun or star. It is a wonder that anything grows on the forest's floor at all.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]
node.description: A malevolent garden borne of secrets unknown to mortals, the forest's edge is inviting to the adventurous of spirit, yet foreboding to the strong of mind. Dark red-tinged creeper vines drape across skeletal claw-like trees, evoking the image of poisonous adders writhing in the sky above.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Canopied Trail]
node.description: Towering ironwoods spread their canopies over the stunted oaks and scrubby pines, the sparsely leafed limbs interlacing in a web of rot-riddled wood that hangs low over the narrow ridge rising up from the forest floor. A few of the lower branches of the trees are broken, as if something large had passed this way recently.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: A ridge heaves up sharply from the forest floor, a long rise of stone and earth curved like a claw. Trees cling to its flanks, their leafy canopies shrouding the world in grey twilight. Smelling of crisp pine and the less pleasant scent of decay, pale mists rise from the black earth and curl through the scatter of rocks and trees.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Thin veils of mist chill the air. Riddled with splotches of fungus, the scaly black trunks of pine trees rise up all around. Overhead, thick branches lock together and support a tangled mat of moss and vines. Brown needles cover the ground, hiding tripping hazards like protruding roots and treacherous stones.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Hollow with distance, throaty ululations worry at the edge of hearing and then vanish. The gnarled and diseased limbs of oak trees are being slowly strangled by black-thorned vines covered with blooms resembling purple spiders. A small patch of weeds clusters around a large rock jutting from the ground.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Cloyingly thick, the omnipresent stench of the stream permeates the area with a sickening miasma. Icy fingers of mist slither around once prospering trees, as if groping blindly for victims to choke. Dim reflections float on the dark waters, shattering and reforming with the slow moving current.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Barely audible, the trickling of water whispers seductively from its unseen source. Lush green vines armed with red thorns smother the eastern flank of the massive oak tree, yielding grudgingly to the grey moss swaying from the leafless limbs. Rocky soils shows dark amidst scraggly patches of thin grass.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Festooned with ropy grey blankets of moss, the gnarled limbs of an enormous oak stretch overhead. Deep gouges, the width of a finger or more, mar the bark of the forest giant. The edges of the gouges are weathered, proving the damage occurred some time ago, yet the tree still weeps viscous dribbles of sap.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: A huge oak tree dominates the center of the clearing, lifting its great branches up to the sky. Crone's hair moss hangs in clumps from the barren limbs while gnarled roots snake out in all directions to trip the unwary. Wan light filters down to cast dappled shadows on the ground.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: Stunted trees press in from all sides, grabbing at hair and clothing. Tatters of grey moss caught in the branches flutter like shrouds snatched from the restless dead. In curious contrast to the distorted trees, a lush carpet of black widow's lace grass provides a gloriously dark setting for colorful mounds of flowering adder's tongue.

node.name: [Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]
node.description: A soft buzzing sound emanates from a hollow beneath one of the silverwillows crowding the banks of a small stream. Grass grows throughout, thinning and losing color as it approaches the waterline. A narrow trail leads southerly towards a healthier region of the forest.

node.name: [Wanderer's Wares, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet and an ironwood armoir along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

node.name: [Wanderer's Wares, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. An ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls, with an ironwood cabinet and an ironwood armoir along the edges of the room. An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

node.name: [Western Road, Low Cliffs]
node.description: Dividing the valley from a rolling plateau, the bluff drops down into rich lowlands and bogs that surround a winding river. A narrow path laced with hoof prints traverses the striated bands composing the rocky face of the bluff and ends at the higher steppe beyond.

node.name: [Western Road, Lowland Valley]
node.description: A thin band of aspen trees laces the borders of a seep -- a deep, waterlogged mat of dead moss and leaves underlying the forest-ringed wetland. Cinnamon and royal ferns thrive in the damp, insulating detritus, and wild calla lilies lift their heart-shaped white faces to the sky. A long bluff stretches out to the west, marking the border of higher lands.

node.name: [Western Road, Lowland Valley]
node.description: A crude stone bridge crosses the Ilaya Gish, its surface worn nearly smooth from repeated seasons of freezing, thawing, and floods. The riverbanks themselves have been reinforced in some places with stones placed behind heavy netting in an effort to keep the waters at bay when snowmelt runs high. Marshy lowlands span the western banks, edging a long bluff.

node.name: [Western Road, Lowland Valley]
node.description: Under the shadow of the Himineldar, the icy waters of the Ilaya Gish come surging out of the mountains, winding their way toward the south. Milky with the burden of suspended minerals carried from the heart of the mountains, the river sprays fans of fine mist in the air as it sluices through the valley.

node.name: [Western Road, Lowland Valley]
node.description: A stone croft sits near the road, its doorframe gaping empty and one wall collapsed. Time and the icy winds have partnered to do a thorough job of erasing any signs of the original inhabitants, and a tangle of silverleaf vines have climbed the remaining walls, ready to begin their patient work of pulling the stonework back down to the waiting earth.

node.name: [Western Road, Lowland Valley]
node.description: Nestled between the Himineldar Shel and the dense forest to the south is a secluded valley quilted with glimmering stretches of marshy fens. From the valley's center spreads a webbing of either footpaths or game trails leading back to the main road.

node.name: [Western Road, Rolling Hills]
node.description: The road slopes over the edge of a band of rolling hills, providing a view of the verdant basin below. Drifts of white mountain heather grow along the hills that crest like emerald-green waves to curve behind the lowlands that stretch along the base of the mountains.

node.name: [Western Road, Rolling Hills]
node.description: Along the edges of a lowland valley, the grassy knolls surrounding the road are so closely cropped that they must be used for grazing. As if in confirmation, the horizon is dotted with tufts of white, grey, and brown that appear to be herds of some kind, though they are too distant to make out clearly. Rocky hills continue to the east, tumbling up to the feet of the mighty Himineldar Shel.

node.name: [Western Road, Rolling Hills]
node.description: A roughly-cut hillside to the west stretches to meet the tall grasses and aspen of the eastern slopes. From somewhere beyond the hill, the wind carries the sounds of goats and sheep bleating and the occasional bark of a sheepdog to echo off rocky slopes in an oddly harmonious duet.

node.name: [Western Road, Rolling Hills]
node.description: The road bends around the base of one of the hills, traveling through an area of thick bear grass and golden switchgrass. Softened by the hillside, a cool breeze whispers through the brush, filling the air with the crisp scent of forests and icy peaks.

node.name: [Western Road, Rolling Hills]
node.description: The jagged slopes of the Himineldar Shel have peppered their lower reaches with blocks of stone that somehow slipped from its grip. Attempts to offset the toll of winter freezes and heavy rains on the road have utilized these fragments of the mountain for repairs and though perhaps a bit bumpy for cart or caravan, they provide a comfortable walk through otherwise rugged terrain.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: Grassy hills to the southwest roll to meet the sweeping base of the Himineldar, their rugged, icy peaks looming over the entire northern landscape and stretching east toward Wyvern Wood and the Dragon Spine Mountains beyond. The road is fairly well maintained, carefully curving around the base of the mountains as it navigates its way through the rough terrain.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: The rocky road leads around the base of a sheer mountain, surrounded by the greenbriar brush and bear grass that cling to the stone-ridden foothills. Nearby lie the remains of a cart, forgotten long ago by the wayside. Only planks from the sideboard and a heavily damaged wheel are left to decay in the chilling winds that claim this trail.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: The side of the mountain has been sheared away. Shattered blocks of rock scattered among the overgrown brush hint that this area may once have been a quarry, though the lush growth of lupine among the fragments show that it is long abandoned. To the east, thin young saplings mark the beginning of a spanning forest, while to the west, rocky grasslands roll down into a basin nestled in the shadows of the Himineldar.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: Flurries of chilling wind sweep down almost constantly from the snow-packed peaks, their icy fingers seeming to search for warmth to destroy. To the north are the majestic Himineldar -- rocky giants laced with ribbons of green trees that grow sparse and then fade away at the uppermost reaches.
