A dense mist hangs around the heights, giving the mountains a hazy, dreamlike aura from this distance. Among the wind-gnarled pines of the foothills, the road continues along its winding path.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: The Himineldar Shel adorn the northwest skyline like a massive sculpture of granite that trails into the far distance. Conifers stunted by icy winds huddle around their base, sometimes scaling up the rocks in nearly-perfect lines. To the west, the road bends away from the forest toward the mountains, traveling a smoother path beneath the deep blue shadow of the peaks.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: Skirting around the base of the great Himineldar, the rugged road dips between foothills, passing jagged chunks of boulder and struggling young trees. Tall clumps of switchgrass have taken hold amongst the mountains, dividing the austere grey crags and crevices with inlets of pale gold.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: The road crests one of the foothills, opening outward to a good view of the forest that stretches into the distance in a tapestry of green and gold and brown. Lodgepole pine trees prevail on these rocky slopes, climbing up the flanks of the mountains like an army holding siege to an icy fortress.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: Tumbling through the lower slopes of the Himineldar, the Western Road travels up and down gentle foothills through an open forest of aspen, pine, and fir. As if confirming the old Dwarven saying, "Mountains make their own weather," thick clouds ring the peaks above. They cluster just below the tree line, paying homage to the rocky, snow-glittered heights.

node.name: [Western Road, Himineldar Foothills]
node.description: The northern horizon darkens with the ice-laden peaks of the Himineldar Shel range. Its slopes flow down to meet the majestic foothills of the Dragon Spine Mountains, as though two mighty serpents of stone and earth have met upon a colossal field of battle and become locked in eternal struggle.

node.name: [Western Road, Open Forest]
node.description: The long, weary road tumbles through lush open forest, nestled between the great mountains that make up this rugged region. As though the earth itself was left uneasy by the heritage of the Dragon Priests, another mountain range has been thrown up in the northwest.

node.name: [Western Road, Open Forest]
node.description: Weaving through groves of rowan trees, the road is dappled with veils of shadow cast by their arching boughs. To the east, towering red cedars begin to fill the skyline as this expansive montane forest collides with the edges of the denser woodlands.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Feathery rowan trees encroach from the west, beginning to mix with the stately cedars that mark the edges of Wyvern Wood. Royal ferns cluster in the damp mounds of earth at the edge of the roadway, their heavy fronds deep green in the shadows of the taller trees.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: The road bends sharply to the southwest, curving around a large cedar tree that has seen fit to grow in the middle of the road. Several rowan trees line the western half of the road around the defiant cedar, while aspen and silverwillow struggle for space and light among the towering forests to the east.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Nestled along the road between the trees is a patch of ground lilies, basking in filtered beams of sunlight. The road is fairly straight and wide, although the presence of slippery piles of leaves and large fallen branches makes the path less than easy going. Tall red cedars trail off into the distance, the larger ones making up the heart of the Wyvern Wood to the east.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Two huge cedar trees bank the road, their branches forming a natural arch overhead. Further from the road larger, older trees abound, their trunks so massive that they stand like the ancient watchtowers of some wildwood civilization.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Stretching to capture any light that can filter down past the mountain peaks and through the dense canopy of cedar, a spindly maple clings to the road's embankment. Its surface roots splay in all directions, forming knotted tangles that require cautious passage.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Thanks to the pervasive forest, a fragrant mat of leaves and conifer needles litters the ground year-round. The damp, cool air carries the tiny symphony of sounds that make up life in these dense woodlands -- the fluting calls of birds, the rattle of branches, and the chanting of tree frogs are nearly always present in varied harmonies.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Dropping from a cleft in the Dragon Spine, Wyvern Wood curves southerly, then wings out toward the western end of the mountain that is its namesake. Its stands of huge cedar trees, punctuated by groves of silverwillow and aspen, form a dense green mosaic unsullied by any signs of civilization.

node.name: [Western Road, Lightly Forested Hills]
node.description: A constant, chill breeze snakes across the road, driven down from somewhere on the upper reaches of the Wyvern's slopes. Little paths reach towards thinly wooded gullies that split the forests to the south, then ghost away, overwhelmed by lush vegetation.

node.name: [Western Road, Lightly Forested Hills]
node.description: Exquisitely sharp peaks throw back the weather that tries to press forward from the warmer climes of the east. Lofting so stark and tall that they swallow the sky, they almost seem to be straining to throw off the bonds of the earth. Often, little showers of pebbles rattle down, tumbling to a final stop on the dark, ice-scoured road.

node.name: [Western Road, Lightly Forested Hills]
node.description: Rolling onward through the hills, the road is roughly channeled, the result of rainwater pouring down the slopes in heavy storms. On either side, the tall pines rise like silent sentinels, guarding the passage to the lands beyond. The surrounding forest is shadowy and quiet, with only occasional rustling from deep amongst the trees revealing the presence of other beings.

node.name: [Western Road, Lightly Forested Hills]
node.description: The crisp scent of evergreens floats though the forested hills, carried by ranks of lodgepole pines. Growing in the shadows of the Spine, the pines are tall and grasping, reaching up for every bit of sunlight. In their dense branches, the bittersweet call of orioles or mockingbirds sounds occasionally, though the wary birds stay well out of sight. Toward the south the pines make way for more rugged country as the road passes below the mountains.

node.name: [Western Road, Below the Spine]
node.description: Flung from the upper slopes as though in protest against any traveler's intrusion, rubble and scree are scattered in all directions. Despite the obstacles, the road continues to wind around the base of the Dragon Spine Range. Toward the northeast, rolling hills lead down into a wide basin that is lush with a green-gold cloak of vegetation. Hulking to the south is Wyvern Mountain, guarding a rocky pass.

node.name: [Western Road, Below the Spine]
node.description: The road is filled with bumps and cracks created by the restless earth under the surrounding mountain ranges. Their rocky peaks dominate the sky and cast constant shadows on the land below.

node.name: [Western Road, Below the Spine]
node.description: Stunted pines and prickly hawthorn grow rampant along the edges of the road. Occasionally, groups of tiny mountain chickadees alight there to search for seeds, then scatter back into the air. The Spine towers to the northeast, its peaks a jagged silhouette.

node.name: [Western Road, Below the Spine]
node.description: Winding along the bottom of otherwise rugged terrain, the road continues to skirt the mountains as they keep watch in timeless vigil. Above, the Dragon Spine begins its curving trek towards the Dragon's Breath Forest, while here only juniper and tufts of white starflowers and the graceful stalks of gold yarrow grace the scene. To the west, the land opens up into swathes of deep green.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: Like a monument crafted by the gods themselves, Wyvern Mountain reaches towards the heavens, its massive circumference dominating the southern landscape. A sparkling haze, heavy with ice crystals, hangs over its upper reaches as the mountain's rocky and sparsely vegetated slopes cascade down to eventually embrace the road beneath.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: Traversing around the base of the mountain, the road is eternally cloaked in shadow as it is greeted on both sides by tall, white-capped peaks. Hardy slopes of juniper and pine flourish to the east, fanning out to meet the Dragon Spine range. Towards the south, the edge of the great Wyvern lifts up at a steady incline, rocky and hazardous.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: A chill breeze rustles periodically through the low brush and plants flanking the scree-covered road. Towards the north, the Dragon Spine can be seen, jutting out like rocky teeth from a nest of brown and green vegetation. Above, Wyvern Mountain looms against the southern skyscape, its jagged profile immense and austere.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: Some unknown force has left one slope of the mountain fire-blackened and sheared nearly smooth. Carved into the base of the slope is a line of flowing, irregular symbols, weathered and almost entirely chipped away. On the other side of the road, a blanket of tiny starflowers covers the scorched land, beginning the cycle of renewal.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: Large boulders hug the foot of the slopes, silently keeping vigil over the road beneath them. Occasionally there are slithering or skittering sounds among the rocks, but no sign of the creatures inhabiting their shadowed crevices. To the north, the Dragon Spine range pushes up towards the sky, a stark frame for the chill reaches of Wyvern Mountain.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: The road rises slightly, continuing its long trek. Wyvern Mountain towers overhead, its misty, snow-capped reaches so distant that they seem almost unreal, as if painted against the sky. A small spring trickles across the road, feeding nearby clusters of mint and sorrel with its mineral-rich water.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: The road narrows slightly as it bends to follow the base of Wyvern Mountain. Shade-loving columbine and blue iris stretch to reach any stray beams of sunlight that manage to filter past the great shadows of the Spine.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: Chunks of rock and debris have fallen from the heights of the mountain to lie scattered haphazardly on the road. The air is dense with the scent of mosses and damp earth, and the sound of Wyvern's great waterfall rumbles all around. To the north, the Dragon Spine Mountains lurch in jagged silhouette against the skyline.

node.name: [Western Road, Foot of Wyvern Mountain]
node.description: A dull roar can be heard from the west as water cascades down the face of Wyvern Mountain, its looming presence casting shadows that absorb light and chill the air. To the east is the Lake of Tears, its waters casting glimmering reflections against the crystal walls of Shard. Around the base of the mountain, a crude road curves into the distance.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: Stretching to capture any light that can filter down past the mountain peaks and through the dense canopy of cedar, a spindly maple clings to the road's embankment. Its surface roots splay in all directions, forming knotted tangles that require cautious passage.

node.name: [Western Road, Wyvern Wood]
node.description: The road bends sharply to the southwest, curving around a large cedar tree that has seen fit to grow in the middle of the road. Several rowan trees line the western half of the road around the defiant cedar, while aspen and silverwillow struggle for space and light among the towering forests to the east.

node.name: [Whimsical Whimsies And Whatnot, Sales Floor]
node.description: A white-veined pink marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A gleaming steel table rising from a central pedestal of carved sana'ati sits on the royal blue glazed-tile floor with silver highlights, with an ornate glass pedestal with carved sana'ati fae legs and an ornate glass bin placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A silver and glass rack with gemstone flowers tucked into the vine-like legs and a large waterwheel with rotating compartments for goods hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls.

node.name: [Whimsical Whimsies And Whatnot, Sales Floor]
node.description: A white-veined pink marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A gleaming steel table rising from a central pedestal of carved sana'ati sits on the royal blue glazed-tile floor with silver highlights, with an ornate glass pedestal with carved sana'ati fae legs and an ornate glass bin placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A silver and glass rack with gemstone flowers tucked into the vine-like legs and a large waterwheel with rotating compartments for goods hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls.

node.name: [Wicked Witch, Sales Floor]
node.description: A marble sales counter with feathered engravings sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A black oak rack and some polished scrimshaw shelves hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a large cabinet painted with colorful moons along the edges of the room. A velvet-covered display and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the soft purple-tiled floor. A steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Wicked Witch, Sales Floor]
node.description: A marble sales counter with feathered engravings sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. Some polished scrimshaw shelves and a black oak rack hang on the tapestry-covered pearwood walls, with a large cabinet painted with colorful moons along the edges of the room. An ornate smokewood chest and a velvet-covered display sit on the soft purple-tiled floor. A steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.

node.name: [Wilds, Pine Needle Path]
node.description: A well-trod path leads from a small open gateway in the town wall and heads into a grove of whispering pine. Lean, muscular figures stride by briskly, some carrying longbows, others staves, and all garbed in muted tones of earth and forest.

node.name: [Wilds, Pine Needle Path]
node.description: Birds dart in and out of the dense shrubbery here, calling to one another in cadences that are almost comprehendible. Responses seem to emanate from the wooden structure ahead, a timber building with ornately carved double doors, and seemingly without a roof.

node.name: [Wilds, Pine Needle Path]
node.description: A well-trod path leads from a small open gateway in the town wall and heads into a grove of whispering pine. Lean, muscular figures stride by briskly, some carrying longbows, others staves, and all garbed in muted tones of earth and forest.

node.name: [Wilds, Pine Needle Path]
node.description: Birds dart in and out of the dense shrubbery here, calling to one another in cadences that are almost comprehendible. Responses seem to emanate from the wooden structure ahead, a timber building with ornately carved double doors, and seemingly without a roof.

node.name: [Wolf Den, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite table and a granite stand sit on the granite floor, with a granite trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor. A glass cabinet stands against the lunat walls. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Wolf Den, Sales Floor]
node.description: A granite sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A granite table and a granite stand sit on the granite floor, with a granite trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options. A puddle-shaped stain mars the floor, and a scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor. A glass cabinet stands against the lunat walls. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Worth The Weight, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass table sits alone on the granite floor, and a glass cabinet stands against the silk-covered walls.

node.name: [Worth The Weight, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A glass table sits alone on the granite floor, and a glass cabinet stands against the silk-covered walls. A swarm of flies buzzes about the room.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Low Tunnel]
node.description: An oppressive darkness surrounds you, however a light in the distance offers hope. The narrow passage offers no room to turn around -- the only option is to continue crawling onward.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Light passes through cracks in the roof of the cavern to reflect silently off the piles of gems and jewelry which lie heaped before a finely-crafted statue of a Dwarven man. Golden leprechauns scamper over the piles of treasure, the natural guardians of such a booty. An onyx raven seems to watch the leprechaun's antics with an expression of detached amusement.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Dragon Shrine]
node.description: Six carved columns of pale marble support an enormous vaulted ceiling. Silvery sand covers the floor, while an enormous dragon, carved of smoky black quartz, lies in the center of the room. The unknown artist who carved the creature depicted it asleep, curled about a jasper globe. Next to it sits a white marble statue of a S'kra Mur woman of twisted body yet serene expression. An open flame burns on an altar on a raised dais near the globe.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Raised Dais]
node.description: The view atop the raised dais is impressive, gazing into the dragon's yawning maw. The artist faceted each individual dragon scale on the smokey black quartz beast, causing them to glitter as they reflect the light. Flames flicker above a white marble altar, though neither wick nor candle may be seen. The overall impression is one of awe, and perhaps... fear.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Black Altar]
node.description: An eerie sense of familiarity pervades the room, from the flames flickering in the air above the black marble altar, to the white marble statue of a S'kra Mur woman dying beneath the claws of a smokey black dragon. A hazy veil of smoke covers one end of the room, while a deep blue-black granite arch seems the only exit.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Low Tunnel]
node.description: An oppressive darkness surrounds you, however a light in the distance offers hope. The narrow passage offers no room to turn around -- the only option is to continue crawling onward.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Light passes through cracks in the roof of the cavern to reflect silently off the piles of gems and jewelry which lie heaped before a finely-crafted statue of a Dwarven man. Golden leprechauns scamper over the piles of treasure, the natural guardians of such a booty. An onyx raven seems to watch the leprechaun's antics with an expression of detached amusement.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Light shines throughout the cavern from a crack in the ceiling. It falls upon a tapestry of a young maiden walking next to a pure white unicorn, which hangs against the rocky walls. Heaped high before the tapestry are sheaves of wheat and ripe fruit, while healing herbs fill wicker baskets on the floor.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Wooden shelves, cracking in the dampness from the cave, line the walls of the room. Books have been piled on every available surface, from grimoires filled with cryptic spells, to a rather sappy epic penned by a young bard. In the center of the room stands a statue of an aloof Elothean male, a black ironwood wolf at his side.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Knives and daggers are mounted on the walls of this cavern, surrounding a mural of an Elven man with ebon skin and long black hair flecked with strands of silver. A night-black panther stalks by his side. Beneath the mural is a small statue of a sleeping child, a peaceful smile on his marble lips.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Swords and armor lie piled haphazardly on racks in this room, surrounding a statue of a wild-haired warrior attended by several youths and maidens. A feral smile lights the statue's face as it seems to gaze at those who pass through the cavern. A stone boar snuffles at the feet of the warrior, the carved bristles and fangs sharply detailed.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: A mural on the wall is bordered by statues of a human and Halfling child. The mural depicts a human man in the prime of life, full of health and vigor, watching over a green field in which children play. Though an indulgent amusement lights his eyes, something about the set of his jaw indicates that his indulgence is tempered with steel. An ox stands by his side, calmly chewing the grass of the field.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]
node.description: Veins of gold and precious gems glitter from the walls of the cave, reflecting what little light exists here. In the center of the cave, a statue of a S'kra Mur male has been sculpted from the stalagmites which litter the floor of the cavern, scorning any foreign marble or granite. A stone cobra rears up before him, hood spread wide and fangs bared in a sibilant hiss of wind.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Raised Dais]
node.description: The view atop the raised dais is impressive, gazing into the dragon's yawning maw. The artist faceted each individual dragon scale on the smokey black quartz beast, causing them to glitter as they reflect the light. Flames flicker above a white marble altar, though neither wick nor candle may be seen. The overall impression is one of awe, and perhaps... fear.

node.name: [Wyvern Mountain, Black Altar]
node.description: An eerie sense of familiarity pervades the room, from the flames flickering in the air above the black marble altar, to the white marble statue of a S'kra Mur woman dying beneath the claws of a smokey black dragon. A hazy veil of smoke covers one end of the room, while a deep blue-black granite arch seems the only exit.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Journey's Rest]
node.description: A small area has been cleared here for travelers to stop and rest before crossing the bridge to Shard's west gate, or stop and recheck their packs before leaving the city's comfortable embrace entirely. Wyvern Mountain stands in the western distance, a great waterfall cascading down its face.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]
node.description: Moonlight reflects off the five towers which dominate the city of Shard, providing a beacon for travelers in the night. The rhythmic lapping of waves against the lake shore mixes with the squelching sound of boots struggling to free themselves from the mud of the trail with each footstep. The trail stretches onward to the west, away from the main road which leads toward Shard.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]
node.description: The trail is firm beneath the feet of the traveler as it winds its way through the farmlands which support the city of Shard. The rich brown soil is perfect for growing grains and fruit, as well as other delicacies to tempt the jaded palate of the city dwellers.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]
node.description: Fields lie fallow and overgrown by weeds, the farms abandoned to time and the wind. With each step, a small cloud of dust rises into the air to hang there for a moment before dispersing.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]
node.description: Tangled scrub brush gives way to taller trees as the trail continues through a forest. Gnarled branches clutch at the clothing of those who journey, traveling ever onward toward their final destination.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]
node.description: The trail is rugged here as it climbs over the rocky terrain near Wyvern Mountain. Dense brush surrounds the trail on all sides as travelers walk warily, lest a wrenched ankle turn the long journey into an agonizing one.

node.name: [Wyvern Trail, Clearing]
node.description: Tangled brush surrounds this small clearing on all sides, save for a narrow trail which leads east. Next to the trail lie the twisted remains of a once mighty oak tree, phosphorescent lichen glowing faintly from its blackened trunk. A faint smell of charred woodsmoke hangs on the still air to tickle the senses. Footprints criss-cross the clearing between the trail and a particularly rough patch of brush.

node.name: [Yrisa's Hut]
node.description: Bits of the hut's leafy canopy dangle down from the vine-bound rafters above. Small holes in the bamboo fortifications whistle shrilly when even the slightest of sea-scented breezes wafts by the simple structure. Footprints come and go as the sandy floor shifts under the weight of patrons. Frequent strong winds from the ocean cause the structure to creak as it shifts under the stress.

node.name: [Yrisa's Hut]
node.description: Bits of the hut's leafy canopy dangle down from the vine-bound rafters above. Small holes in the bamboo fortifications whistle shrilly when even the slightest of sea-scented breezes wafts by the simple structure. Footprints come and go as the sandy floor shifts under the weight of patrons. Frequent strong winds from the ocean cause the structure to creak as it shifts under the stress.

node.name: [Yrs' Greatest Deals, Sales Floor]
node.description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin. A steel worktable and an oaken table sit on the bare floor. An oak locker stands against the oaken walls.
